topics.title: Education & Learning
topics.description: Từ vựng về hệ thống giáo dục, cơ hội học tập và quá trình phát triển kỹ năng.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; invest in/expand + early childhood education
examples: Early childhood education narrows the gap before school even starts.
The city has doubled its spending on early childhood education.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; extend/complete + compulsory education
examples: Compulsory education now ends at the age of sixteen.
Vietnam extended compulsory education to nine years.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; enter/widen access to + higher education
examples: Higher education remains out of reach for many rural families.
She was the first in her family to enter higher education.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; provide/undergo + vocational training
examples: Vocational training prepares school leavers for skilled trades.
The factory provides vocational training for new recruits.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; attend/go to + a state school
examples: Most children in the district attend a state school.
State schools receive their funding from local taxes.

items.meaning: việc học thêm có trả phí
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; pay for/rely on + private tuition
examples: Wealthier parents pay for private tuition before the entrance exam.
Private tuition gives some candidates an unfair advantage.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; send sb to/be at + a boarding school
examples: His parents sent him to a boarding school at the age of eleven.
Boarding schools charge far more than day schools.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; through/by + distance learning
examples: Distance learning allows nurses to study while they work.
She completed her degree through distance learning.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; promote/be committed to + lifelong learning
examples: Lifelong learning helps older workers stay employable.
The library promotes lifelong learning through free courses.

items.meaning: khả năng đọc viết của người lớn
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; improve/raise + adult literacy
examples: Adult literacy has improved sharply over two decades.
The programme raised adult literacy in three provinces.

items.definition: số nhiều curricula hoặc curriculums; design/reform/follow + the curriculum
examples: The national curriculum was reformed to include coding.
Teachers have little freedom to depart from the curriculum.
A crowded curriculum leaves no room for the arts.

items.definition: số nhiều syllabuses hoặc syllabi; cover/set + a syllabus
examples: The syllabus lists every text we have to read.
We covered the whole syllabus two weeks before the exam.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; take/drop + a core subject
examples: Maths remains a core subject until the age of sixteen.
Students cannot drop a core subject before the final year.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; choose/sign up for + an elective course
examples: Each student chooses two elective courses a term.
The elective course on film studies filled up within an hour.

items.definition: thường ở số nhiều; take part in + extracurricular activities
examples: Extracurricular activities build confidence as much as skill.
She takes part in three extracurricular activities a week.

items.meaning: bài tập tính điểm trong quá trình học
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; hand in/mark + coursework
examples: Coursework counts for forty per cent of the final grade.
He handed in his coursework a day late.

items.definition: thường ở số nhiều; prepare/adapt + teaching materials
examples: The teacher adapts her teaching materials for each class.
Free teaching materials are now available online.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; write/follow + a lesson plan
examples: A clear lesson plan keeps a large class on task.
New teachers write a lesson plan for every session.

items.meaning: khối lượng công việc hoặc bài vở
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; reduce/cope with + a heavy workload
examples: Final-year students face a heavy workload.
The school cut the homework workload after complaints.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; take/pass/fail + a module
examples: Each module is assessed by an essay and a presentation.
She failed one module and had to retake it.

items.meaning: việc đánh giá, kiểm tra đánh giá
items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; carry out/sit + an assessment
examples: Continuous assessment reduces the pressure of a single exam.
The school carries out an assessment every half term.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; sit/pass/fail + an entrance exam
examples: Thousands of candidates sit the entrance exam each June.
She passed the entrance exam without any private tuition.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; sit/mark + a mock exam
examples: Mock exams show students where their weaknesses lie.
He scored far better in the real test than in the mock exam.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; raise/measure + academic achievement
examples: Academic achievement depends on far more than natural ability.
The reform aimed to raise academic achievement in poorer areas.

items.meaning: kết quả học tập cần đạt
items.definition: thường ở số nhiều; define/meet + learning outcomes
examples: Every module states its learning outcomes in advance.
The course failed to meet its stated learning outcomes.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; raise/report + a pass rate
examples: The pass rate rose from sixty to eighty per cent.
Schools are judged too narrowly on their pass rate.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; reduce/cut + the dropout rate
examples: The dropout rate is highest in the first year.
Free meals helped cut the dropout rate in half.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; request/submit + a transcript
examples: Applicants must submit an official transcript.
Her transcript shows consistently high marks.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; lead to/tackle + grade inflation
examples: Grade inflation makes it harder to compare candidates.
Universities deny that grade inflation has taken place.

items.meaning: nhận xét, phản hồi về bài làm
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; give/act on + feedback
examples: Written feedback helps more than a bare mark.
She acted on her tutor's feedback and rewrote the essay.

items.meaning: sinh viên đại học chưa tốt nghiệp
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; dùng được như tính từ: undergraduate course
examples: The lecture hall holds four hundred undergraduates.
She teaches both undergraduates and postgraduates.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; dùng được như tính từ: postgraduate research
examples: Postgraduates receive a small monthly stipend.
He stayed on as a postgraduate after his degree.

items.meaning: người đi học khi đã lớn tuổi
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; return as/enrol as + a mature student
examples: Mature students often bring workplace experience to seminars.
She returned to university as a mature student at forty.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; work as/be supported by + a teaching assistant
examples: A teaching assistant works with the weakest readers.
He paid his way through graduate school as a teaching assistant.

items.meaning: giảng viên hướng dẫn, gia sư
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; cũng là động từ: tutor sb in + N
examples: My tutor reads every draft before I submit it.
She tutors two children in maths after school.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; appoint/be appointed + head teacher
examples: The new head teacher reorganised the whole timetable.
Parents wrote to the head teacher about class sizes.

items.meaning: người cùng nhóm, bạn đồng trang lứa
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; thường trong peer pressure, peer review
examples: Pupils learn as much from their peers as from teachers.
Peer pressure pushed him to stay in school.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; reduce/cap + class size
examples: Smaller class sizes allow more individual attention.
The ministry capped class size at thirty-five.

items.meaning: toàn thể người học của một trường
items.definition: danh từ số ít; a diverse/growing + student body
examples: The university has a highly diverse student body.
The student body voted against the fee increase.

items.definition: số nhiều của alumnus; donate/network with + alumni
examples: Alumni funded the new library wing.
The school keeps in touch with its alumni.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; develop/encourage + critical thinking
examples: Critical thinking cannot be taught through memorisation.
Seminars are designed to develop critical thinking.

items.meaning: khả năng giải quyết vấn đề
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; dùng được như tính từ: problem-solving skills
examples: Group tasks build problem-solving as well as teamwork.
Employers value problem-solving above exam results.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; poor/improve + time management
examples: Poor time management explains most missed deadlines.
A simple planner improved her time management.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; practise/improve + note-taking
examples: Effective note-taking saves hours of revision later.
He practises note-taking while listening to podcasts.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; rely on/move away from + rote learning
examples: Rote learning produces marks but little understanding.
The new syllabus moves away from rote learning.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; encourage/be based on + independent study
examples: The final year is based mainly on independent study.
Independent study suits motivated learners.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; take part in/assess + group work
examples: Group work teaches students to divide a task fairly.
Marking group work fairly is notoriously difficult.

items.meaning: việc đánh giá chéo giữa người học
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; through/subject to + peer review
examples: Essays improve after a round of peer review.
Every article goes through peer review before publication.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được (nghĩa ôn tập); do/plan + revision
examples: She draws up a revision timetable six weeks in advance.
Most of his revision happens in the library.

items.definition: danh từ số nhiều; teach/build + study skills
examples: First-year students attend a course on study skills.
Good study skills matter more than long hours.

items.meaning: quyền hoặc cơ hội tiếp cận
items.definition: have/gain/lack/widen + access to + N
examples: Rural pupils still lack access to reliable internet.
The scheme gives low-income families access to free textbooks.
Access to higher education has widened since 2015.

items.definition: danh từ số nhiều; pay/raise/waive + tuition fees
examples: Tuition fees have tripled in a single generation.
The university waived tuition fees for care leavers.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; win/award/be on + a scholarship
examples: She won a full scholarship to study abroad.
The foundation awards thirty scholarships a year.

items.meaning: khoản vay dành cho sinh viên
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; take out/repay + a student loan
examples: He took out a student loan to cover his rent.
Graduates repay their student loan once they earn enough.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; run up/write off + student debt
examples: Student debt now follows graduates into their forties.
Some countries have written off student debt entirely.

items.meaning: bất bình đẳng trong giáo dục
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; tackle/reinforce + educational inequality
examples: Educational inequality begins long before primary school.
Streaming by ability can reinforce educational inequality.

items.meaning: khả năng dịch chuyển tầng lớp xã hội
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; improve/limit + social mobility
examples: Education is still the strongest driver of social mobility.
Expensive tuition limits social mobility.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; promote/move towards + inclusive education
examples: Inclusive education keeps disabled children in mainstream classes.
The policy moves the system towards inclusive education.

items.meaning: nhu cầu giáo dục đặc biệt
items.definition: danh từ số nhiều, viết tắt SEN; have/support + special educational needs
examples: Children with special educational needs receive extra support.
The school employs two specialists for special educational needs.

items.meaning: mở rộng cơ hội vào đại học
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; a widening participation + scheme/target
examples: Widening participation schemes target under-represented groups.
The university missed its widening participation target.

items.definition: enrol in/on + N (khoá học); enrol at + N (trường)
examples: Nearly two thousand students enrol on the course each year.
She enrolled at a local college after finishing school.

items.definition: graduate from + N (trường); graduate in + N (ngành)
examples: He graduated from Hue University in 2019.
She graduated in economics with the highest marks in her year.

items.definition: major in + N (ngành học); dùng nhiều ở tiếng Anh Mỹ
examples: He decided to major in environmental science.
Students who major in languages often spend a year abroad.

items.definition: specialise in + N hoặc V-ing
examples: The institute specialises in teacher training.
She specialises in teaching children with dyslexia.

items.definition: excel at/in + N hoặc V-ing
examples: She excels at mathematics but struggles with essays.
Pupils excel in subjects their teachers love.

items.definition: grasp + N; cũng là danh từ: have a firm grasp of + N
examples: Most children grasp the idea after one clear example.
He has a firm grasp of the underlying theory.

items.definition: memorise + N; dạng Mỹ viết memorize
examples: Candidates memorise whole essays instead of learning to argue.
She memorised fifty new words a week.

items.definition: retake + N (môn, kì thi)
examples: He had to retake two modules in the summer.
Students may retake the exam only once.

items.definition: supervise + N (người, luận văn)
examples: Professor Tran supervises eight doctoral students.
A teacher supervises the exam hall at all times.

items.definition: mentor + sb; cũng là danh từ đếm được
examples: Final-year students mentor newcomers in their first term.
A good mentor changed the direction of her career.

items.meaning: có tính học thuật, thuộc về học tập
items.definition: academic + N; be academic (nghiêng về lí thuyết)
examples: Her academic record opened every door.
The debate is purely academic until funding arrives.

items.definition: rigorous + N (standards, testing, training)
examples: The course has a rigorous selection process.
Rigorous marking protects the value of the degree.

items.definition: a selective + N; be selective about + N
examples: Selective schools admit only the top ten per cent.
Employers are increasingly selective about qualifications.

items.definition: a prestigious + N (university, award, scholarship)
examples: He turned down a place at a prestigious university.
The prize is the most prestigious award in the field.

items.definition: affordable + N; make sth affordable for + N
examples: Affordable childcare lets more mothers return to study.
Online courses make retraining affordable for older workers.

items.definition: an intensive + N (course, programme)
examples: She took an intensive language course before moving.
Intensive revision in the final month rarely works.

items.definition: interactive + N (lesson, whiteboard, task)
examples: Interactive lessons hold a young class far longer.
The museum built an interactive exhibit for schools.

items.definition: hands-on + N (experience, training); luôn có gạch nối
examples: Hands-on experience matters more than a long reading list.
Apprentices get hands-on training from the first week.

items.definition: a well-rounded + N (education, candidate)
examples: A well-rounded education includes sport and music.
Universities look for well-rounded candidates.

items.definition: a gifted + N; be gifted at/in + N
examples: Gifted pupils often go unnoticed in large classes.
She is gifted at languages but bored by routine drills.

items.definition: disruptive + N (behaviour, pupil)
examples: Disruptive behaviour costs the whole class learning time.
Two disruptive pupils can unsettle a lesson.

items.meaning: chú ý, tập trung lắng nghe
items.definition: be attentive to + N; an attentive + N
examples: The class stayed attentive for the full hour.
Attentive teachers notice problems early.

items.meaning: biết đọc biết viết, thông thạo một lĩnh vực
items.definition: be literate; digitally/financially literate
examples: Only half the adult population was literate in 1950.
Graduates are expected to be digitally literate.

items.definition: be numerate; dùng cặp với literate
examples: Employers want staff who are both literate and numerate.
The test checks whether applicants are numerate.

items.meaning: diễn đạt rõ ràng, lưu loát
items.definition: be articulate; an articulate + N (tính từ đọc /ɑːˈtɪkjələt/)
examples: She is articulate under pressure, which helps in interviews.
Debating clubs produce articulate speakers.

items.definition: be proficient in/at + N hoặc V-ing
examples: Candidates must be proficient in at least two languages.
He became proficient at coding within a year.

items.definition: be competent to + V; a competent + N
examples: A competent teacher can rescue a poor textbook.
She is competent to supervise laboratory work.

items.definition: be motivated to + V; highly motivated + N
examples: Motivated learners need less supervision.
She was motivated to finish the course by a job offer.

items.definition: a demanding + N; be demanding of + N
examples: The programme is demanding but well supported.
Medicine is the most demanding degree on offer.

items.definition: be accessible to + N; make sth accessible
examples: The lecture notes are accessible to complete beginners.
Subtitles make recorded lectures accessible to more students.

items.definition: drop out of + N; không tách được
examples: Nearly one in ten students drops out of the first year.
He dropped out of university to care for his mother.

items.meaning: theo kịp phần đã bỏ lại
items.definition: catch up with + N; catch up on + N (bài vở)
examples: Extra classes help absentees catch up with the group.
She spent the holiday catching up on missed coursework.

items.definition: fall behind + (with) N; không tách được
examples: Children fall behind quickly after a long absence.
He fell behind with his reading in the second term.

items.definition: keep up with + N; không tách được
examples: Weaker readers struggle to keep up with the syllabus.
It is hard to keep up with the pace of the lectures.

items.definition: brush up on + N; không tách được
examples: I need to brush up on my statistics before the exam.
She brushed up on her French before the exchange.

items.definition: hand in + N hoặc hand + N + in; tách được
examples: Please hand in your essays by Friday.
He wrote the report on Sunday and handed it in on Monday.

items.definition: hand out + N hoặc hand + N + out; tách được
examples: The teacher handed out the worksheets.
She printed fifty copies and handed them out.

items.definition: go over + N; không tách được
examples: We go over the previous lesson for five minutes.
Go over your answers before you leave the room.

items.definition: sign up for + N; không tách được
examples: Forty pupils signed up for the coding club.
You can sign up for the workshop online.

items.definition: read up on + N; không tách được
examples: Read up on the topic before the seminar.
She read up on the subject over the summer.

items.meaning: tính ra, tìm ra đáp án
items.definition: work out + N hoặc work + N + out; tách được
examples: Work out the average before you draw the graph.
He could not work the problem out on his own.

items.definition: write up + N hoặc write + N + up; tách được
examples: She spent a week writing up her results.
Take notes in the lab and write them up the same day.

items.definition: sum up + N hoặc sum + N + up; tách được
examples: The final slide sums up the whole argument.
Let me sum up the three main findings.

items.definition: point out + that + mệnh đề hoặc point out + N; tách được
examples: The examiner pointed out two errors in the method.
She pointed out that the data covered only one city.

items.definition: carry out + N (research, survey, experiment); tách được
examples: The team carried out a survey of two hundred schools.
We carried the experiment out three times.

items.definition: take up + N hoặc take + N + up; tách được
examples: Many students take up a new language in their first term.
He took up teaching after a decade in industry.

items.meaning: làm quen với môi trường mới
items.definition: settle in; settle into + N
examples: Most first-years settle in within a month.
She settled into the new school surprisingly fast.

items.definition: look up + N hoặc look + N + up; tách được
examples: Look up any word you cannot infer from context.
He wrote the term down and looked it up later.

items.definition: get to grips with + N; không tách được
examples: It takes a term to get to grips with statistics.
She finally got to grips with the referencing system.

items.definition: drop behind + N; gần nghĩa fall behind
examples: Pupils who miss the basics drop behind the class.
He dropped behind the others after a long illness.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; improve/basic + literacy
examples: Literacy rates rose fastest among girls.
The charity teaches basic literacy to adults.

items.meaning: khả năng tính toán cơ bản
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; poor/improve + numeracy
examples: Poor numeracy limits people's choices at work.
The school added an extra hour of numeracy a week.

items.meaning: năng khiếu, khả năng tự nhiên
items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; an aptitude for + N
examples: She showed an early aptitude for music.
The test measures aptitude rather than knowledge.

items.meaning: mức đạt được trong học tập
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; raise/low + attainment
examples: Attainment in science has stalled for a decade.
The gap in attainment widens every year of school.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; tackle/reduce + truancy
examples: Truancy rose sharply after the lockdown.
Home visits helped the school tackle truancy.

items.definition: không đếm được (kỉ luật); đếm được (ngành học)
examples: Good discipline frees a teacher to teach.
Economics borrows methods from other disciplines.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; lose/sustain + motivation
examples: Motivation falls when feedback arrives too late.
Clear goals sustain motivation through a long course.

items.meaning: khát vọng, mong muốn vươn lên
items.definition: thường ở số nhiều; raise/lower + aspirations
examples: Mentoring raised the aspirations of the whole year group.
Low expectations lower children's aspirations.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; poor/improve/monitor + attendance
examples: Attendance improved once breakfast was provided.
The office monitors attendance every morning.

items.definition: không đếm được; rise/fall in + enrolment (Mỹ: enrollment)
examples: Enrolment in engineering fell for the third year.
The village school closed after enrolment collapsed.

items.meaning: đợt tuyển sinh, số tuyển vào
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; this year's/cap + the intake
examples: This year's intake is the largest on record.
The department capped its intake at sixty.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a cohort of + N
examples: The 2020 cohort sat no formal exams.
We followed a cohort of five hundred pupils for ten years.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; the autumn/spring + semester
examples: The semester ends with a two-week exam period.
She spent one semester at a partner university.

items.definition: đếm được (khoa); không đếm được ở Mỹ (giảng viên)
examples: The Faculty of Education moved to a new building.
Faculty are consulted before any change to the syllabus.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; write/submit + a dissertation
examples: Her dissertation ran to eighty pages.
Students submit a dissertation in the final term.

items.definition: số nhiều theses; defend/argue + a thesis
examples: He defended his thesis in front of three examiners.
The thesis of the article is stated in the first paragraph.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; detect/amount to + plagiarism
examples: The software detects plagiarism across millions of sources.
Copying two sentences unacknowledged still amounts to plagiarism.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; include/check + citations
examples: Every claim needs a citation.
The marker checked all forty citations.

items.meaning: danh mục tài liệu tham khảo
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; compile/include + a bibliography
examples: A full bibliography follows the conclusion.
She compiled the bibliography as she read.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; attend/lead + a seminar
examples: Seminars are limited to twelve students.
He leads a seminar on research methods.

items.meaning: buổi hướng dẫn riêng hoặc nhóm rất nhỏ
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; have/miss + a tutorial
examples: Each student has a weekly tutorial with a supervisor.
She missed two tutorials because of illness.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; give/attend + a lecture
examples: The lecture was recorded for those who could not attend.
He gives the same lecture twice a week.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; run/take part in + a workshop
examples: The library runs a workshop on academic writing.
Thirty teachers took part in the workshop.

items.meaning: hình thức học nghề có trả lương
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; serve/complete + an apprenticeship
examples: He completed a four-year apprenticeship as an electrician.
Apprenticeships combine paid work with study.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; do/secure + an internship
examples: She secured a summer internship at a research centre.
Unpaid internships favour students with wealthy parents.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; hold/gain + a qualification
examples: The post requires a teaching qualification.
He gained his first qualification at twenty-five.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; do/hold + a degree in + N
examples: She holds a degree in civil engineering.
Doing a degree part-time takes twice as long.

items.meaning: bằng cao đẳng, văn bằng ngắn hạn
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; earn/award + a diploma
examples: The college awards a diploma after two years.
He earned a diploma in hotel management.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; request/read + a prospectus
examples: The prospectus lists every module on offer.
She requested prospectuses from six universities.

items.meaning: việc chia lớp theo trình độ
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; introduce/abolish + streaming
examples: Streaming by ability divides pupils from the age of eleven.
The school abolished streaming in mathematics.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; face/ease + a teacher shortage
examples: Rural districts face a severe teacher shortage.
Better pay would ease the teacher shortage.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; invest in/undergo + teacher training
examples: Teacher training now includes a year in the classroom.
The ministry invested heavily in teacher training.

items.meaning: người vừa rời ghế phổ thông
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; thường ở số nhiều
examples: School leavers without qualifications struggle to find work.
The scheme guarantees every school leaver an interview.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; be under/relieve + academic pressure
examples: Teenagers are under constant academic pressure.
Dropping the ranking system relieved some academic pressure.

items.meaning: sự tham gia của phụ huynh
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; encourage/high levels of + parental involvement
examples: Parental involvement predicts progress better than income.
The school encourages parental involvement in reading.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; opt for/regulate + home schooling
examples: A small number of families opt for home schooling.
Home schooling is loosely regulated in many countries.

items.meaning: kết hợp học trực tiếp và trực tuyến
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; adopt/move to + blended learning
examples: The university adopted blended learning after the pandemic.
Blended learning suits students who work part-time.

items.meaning: năng lực sử dụng công nghệ số
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; teach/lack + digital literacy
examples: Digital literacy is now as basic as reading.
Older learners often lack digital literacy.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; have/be diagnosed with + a learning difficulty
examples: One pupil in twelve has a diagnosed learning difficulty.
Learning difficulties are often mistaken for laziness.

items.meaning: khoảng thời gian tập trung được
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a short/lengthen + attention span
examples: Young children have a short attention span.
Breaking the lesson into parts suits a short attention span.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; develop/encourage + a growth mindset
examples: A growth mindset treats failure as information.
Teachers try to encourage a growth mindset from year one.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; create/a supportive + learning environment
examples: A quiet learning environment matters more than new equipment.
The redesign created a more supportive learning environment.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; poor/effective + classroom management
examples: Classroom management is the hardest skill for new teachers.
Effective classroom management prevents most conflict.

items.meaning: mức độ tham gia của người học
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; boost/measure + student engagement
examples: Short tasks boost student engagement in long lessons.
Attendance is a crude measure of student engagement.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; uphold/breach + academic integrity
examples: Every student signs a statement on academic integrity.
Buying an essay is a clear breach of academic integrity.

items.meaning: đánh giá liên tục trong quá trình học
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; move to/rely on + continuous assessment
examples: Continuous assessment rewards steady work.
The school moved to continuous assessment in 2021.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; rely on/criticise + standardised testing
examples: Standardised testing allows comparison between schools.
Critics say standardised testing narrows the curriculum.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; top/publish + a league table
examples: League tables push schools to select easier subjects.
The paper publishes a league table every August.

items.meaning: khu vực tuyển sinh theo địa bàn
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; live in/fall within + a catchment area
examples: House prices rise inside a good catchment area.
The family fell just outside the catchment area.

items.meaning: năm nghỉ giữa phổ thông và đại học
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; take/spend + a gap year
examples: She took a gap year to work and travel.
A gap year can strengthen a university application.

items.definition: study abroad (không có giới từ); dùng được như tính từ: a study abroad programme
examples: More graduates choose to study abroad for a master's.
He studied abroad for one semester.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; go on/organise + a field trip
examples: The geography class went on a field trip to the delta.
Field trips cost money many families do not have.

items.meaning: ngày mở cửa tham quan trường
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; hold/attend + an open day
examples: The university holds an open day each September.
We attended three open days before deciding.

items.meaning: công tác hỗ trợ tinh thần cho học sinh
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; provide/strengthen + pastoral care
examples: Pastoral care keeps vulnerable pupils in school.
The school strengthened pastoral care after the inspection.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; offer/seek + careers advice
examples: Good careers advice prevents expensive mistakes.
Few pupils receive careers advice before choosing subjects.

items.meaning: phúc lợi và sức khoẻ của người học
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; look after/a student welfare + officer
examples: A welfare officer looks after student welfare on campus.
Student welfare was ignored during the expansion.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; cope with/reduce + exam pressure
examples: Exam pressure peaks in the final two months.
Teaching revision skills reduces exam pressure.

items.meaning: lớp có nhiều trình độ khác nhau
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; teach/differentiate in + a mixed-ability class
examples: Teaching a mixed-ability class demands careful planning.
In a mixed-ability class the fastest pupils finish early.

items.definition: sit + N (exam, test); dạng Mỹ dùng take an exam
examples: Candidates sit the exam in three separate sessions.
He sat the same exam twice.

items.definition: set + N (homework, a task, a deadline)
examples: Teachers set homework twice a week.
She sets a short reading task every Friday.

items.definition: mark + N; dạng Mỹ dùng grade
examples: It takes an hour to mark an essay properly.
He marked thirty essays over the weekend.

items.meaning: dạy hết nội dung chương trình
items.definition: cover + N (syllabus, material, ground)
examples: We cover the syllabus by the end of April.
Rushing to cover the syllabus leaves gaps.

items.definition: hit the books (không đổi hình thức)
examples: I need to hit the books before the final exam.
She hit the books as soon as the dates were announced.

items.meaning: học cách làm một việc mới
items.definition: learn the ropes (thường ở thì tiếp diễn hoặc hoàn thành)
examples: New teachers spend a term learning the ropes.
He has already learnt the ropes in the laboratory.

items.meaning: đỗ với kết quả xuất sắc
items.definition: pass + N + with flying colours
examples: She passed with flying colours in all four papers.
All four candidates passed with flying colours.

items.meaning: giai đoạn phải học rất nhiều trong thời gian ngắn
items.definition: have/face + a steep learning curve
examples: The first month was a steep learning curve.
Anyone switching field faces a steep learning curve.

items.definition: learn + N + by heart
examples: We had to learn twenty lines of poetry by heart.
Learning formulas by heart is no substitute for understanding.

items.definition: know + N + inside out
examples: She knows the syllabus inside out.
After ten years he knows the subject inside out.

items.definition: play truant (Anh); play hooky (Mỹ)
examples: A handful of pupils played truant all term.
He was caught playing truant twice.

items.meaning: thức khuya học hoặc làm việc
items.definition: burn the midnight oil (không có tân ngữ)
examples: Students burn the midnight oil in the final week.
She burnt the midnight oil to finish the dissertation.

items.definition: think outside the box (không có tân ngữ)
examples: The task rewards students who think outside the box.
Examiners welcome candidates who think outside the box.

items.definition: give/provide + sb + food for thought
examples: The lecture gave us plenty of food for thought.
Her final question was real food for thought.

items.meaning: đưa lí thuyết vào thực hành
items.definition: put + N + into practice
examples: Placements let trainees put theory into practice.
The workshop puts the reading into practice.

items.meaning: hiểu và nhất trí với nhau
items.definition: be on the same page (as + sb)
examples: The teacher checks that everyone is on the same page.
Parents and staff are now on the same page.

items.definition: do/take + a crash course in + N
examples: He took a crash course in statistics before the project.
A crash course in referencing would save them hours.

items.meaning: từ đầu, từ con số không
items.definition: learn/start + sth + from scratch
examples: She learnt Mandarin from scratch in two years.
The department rebuilt the course from scratch.

items.meaning: làm tắt, bỏ bước để tiết kiệm công sức
items.definition: cut corners (on + N)
examples: Students who cut corners are caught at the viva.
You cannot cut corners on laboratory safety.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; get/award/raise + a grade (Mỹ dùng cả làm động từ)
examples: She needs a high grade to keep her scholarship.
The board awards grades from A to E.

items.meaning: ôn tập; sửa lại bản viết
items.definition: revise for + N (kì thi); revise + N (bản thảo)
examples: He revised for the exam every evening.
She revised the introduction three times.

items.definition: cram for + N; nhân đôi phụ âm: cramming, crammed
examples: Cramming the night before rarely raises a grade.
They crammed for the test during the lunch break.

items.meaning: bỏ qua, nghỉ không lí do
items.definition: skip + N (a lesson, a chapter); nhân đôi phụ âm
examples: He skipped two lessons and lost the thread.
Do not skip the chapter on method.

items.definition: expel + sb + from + N; thường ở dạng bị động
examples: Two pupils were expelled from the school.
The college rarely expels a student for a first offence.

items.definition: suspend + sb + from + N; thường ở dạng bị động
examples: He was suspended from classes for a week.
The university suspended three students pending an inquiry.

items.definition: invigilate + N hoặc invigilate at + N (Mỹ: proctor)
examples: Two teachers invigilate every public exam.
She invigilated at the entrance test on Saturday.

items.definition: cite + N (a study, an author, a figure)
examples: The essay cites fifteen peer-reviewed studies.
He cited the wrong edition of the book.

items.meaning: diễn đạt lại bằng lời khác
items.definition: paraphrase + N; cũng là danh từ đếm được
examples: Paraphrase the source rather than quoting it in full.
A weak paraphrase keeps the original word order.

items.definition: summarise + N; dạng Mỹ viết summarize
examples: Summarise the article in a hundred words.
She summarised the debate for the latecomers.

items.definition: annotate + N (a text, a diagram)
examples: Annotate the passage before you answer.
He annotates every book he reads.

items.meaning: củng cố kiến thức đã học
items.definition: consolidate + N (learning, knowledge, gains)
examples: A short quiz consolidates the morning's learning.
The holiday task consolidates work from the whole term.

items.definition: deliver + N (a lecture, a talk, a presentation)
examples: She delivers the opening lecture every September.
He delivered a lecture on urban history.

topics.title: Environment & Climate
topics.description: Từ vựng về khí hậu, bảo tồn tài nguyên và các chính sách môi trường.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; tackle/adapt to/accelerate + climate change
examples: Climate change is already reshaping the rice calendar.
No single country can tackle climate change alone.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; slow/contribute to + global warming
examples: Global warming has pushed average temperatures up by one degree.
Burning coal contributes directly to global warming.

items.meaning: khí gây hiệu ứng nhà kính
items.definition: thường ở số nhiều; emit/cut + greenhouse gases
examples: Agriculture emits more greenhouse gases than aviation.
The plan cuts greenhouse gases by a third.

items.definition: danh từ số nhiều; reduce/offset + carbon emissions
examples: Carbon emissions fell during the lockdown.
The airline offsets its carbon emissions by planting trees.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; have/shrink + a carbon footprint
examples: Air freight has an enormous carbon footprint.
Eating less meat shrinks a household's carbon footprint.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; extreme weather + events
examples: Extreme weather now hits the region twice a year.
Insurers have raised premiums because of extreme weather.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a heatwave + hits/breaks
examples: A heatwave closed schools across the north.
The city recorded its longest heatwave on record.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; suffer/be hit by + drought
examples: Three years of drought emptied the reservoirs.
Farmers in the highlands were hit hardest by the drought.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; cause/be prone to + flash flooding
examples: Concrete surfaces make flash flooding worse.
The valley is prone to flash flooding in September.

items.definition: danh từ số nhiều; threaten/be displaced by + rising sea levels
examples: Rising sea levels threaten the entire delta.
Whole villages have moved inland because of rising sea levels.

items.meaning: hiện tượng axit hoá đại dương
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; cause/accelerate + ocean acidification
examples: Ocean acidification dissolves the shells of young oysters.
Extra carbon dioxide accelerates ocean acidification.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; halt/lead to + desertification
examples: Overgrazing leads to desertification within a decade.
Tree belts have halted desertification along the border.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; prevent/accelerate + soil erosion
examples: Removing hedgerows accelerates soil erosion.
Terracing prevents soil erosion on steep slopes.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; reduce/be exposed to + air pollution
examples: Air pollution shortens life expectancy in the capital.
Children near main roads are exposed to the worst air pollution.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; cause/monitor + water pollution
examples: Untreated sewage causes most water pollution here.
Volunteers monitor water pollution in the estuary.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; suffer from/limit + noise pollution
examples: Residents near the airport suffer from noise pollution.
A night-flight ban would limit noise pollution.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; reduce/be affected by + light pollution
examples: Light pollution hides all but the brightest stars.
Migrating birds are badly affected by light pollution.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; thick/be covered in + smog
examples: Thick smog closed the motorway for two days.
The city sits under smog for most of the winter.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; cause/be damaged by + acid rain
examples: Acid rain stripped the leaves from entire forests.
Limestone buildings are slowly damaged by acid rain.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; absorb/release + carbon dioxide
examples: Forests absorb carbon dioxide as they grow.
Cement production releases huge amounts of carbon dioxide.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; invest in/switch to + renewable energy
examples: Renewable energy now supplies a third of the grid.
The province switched to renewable energy in five years.

items.definition: thường ở số nhiều; burn/move away from + fossil fuels
examples: Fossil fuels still dominate heavy industry.
Moving away from fossil fuels requires new storage.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; generate/run on + solar power
examples: Rooftop panels generate solar power for the whole block.
The pumping station runs entirely on solar power.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; build/oppose + a wind farm
examples: An offshore wind farm will power sixty thousand homes.
Local residents opposed the wind farm on visual grounds.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; rely on/expand + hydropower
examples: The country relies on hydropower for most of its electricity.
Expanding hydropower floods farmland upstream.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; phase out/debate + nuclear power
examples: Nuclear power produces no carbon while it runs.
Germany decided to phase out nuclear power entirely.

items.meaning: hiệu quả sử dụng năng lượng
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; improve/standards for + energy efficiency
examples: Insulation is the cheapest route to energy efficiency.
New appliances must meet strict energy efficiency standards.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; cut/measure + energy consumption
examples: Household energy consumption peaks in January.
Smart meters let families measure energy consumption hourly.

items.definition: danh từ số nhiều; exploit/manage + natural resources
examples: The delta's natural resources support millions of people.
Natural resources are being exploited faster than they recover.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; upgrade/connect to + the power grid
examples: The old power grid cannot absorb so much solar output.
Remote villages were connected to the power grid last year.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; protect/loss of + biodiversity
examples: Biodiversity is highest where habitats remain unbroken.
The loss of biodiversity is hardest to reverse.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a fragile/restore + an ecosystem
examples: Mangroves form one of the richest ecosystems on the coast.
It takes decades to restore a damaged ecosystem.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; cause/slow + habitat loss
examples: Habitat loss drives more extinctions than hunting.
Road building causes habitat loss far from the road itself.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; halt/rate of + deforestation
examples: Deforestation has slowed but not stopped.
Cattle farming drives most deforestation in the basin.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; a reforestation + programme/scheme
examples: A reforestation programme planted two million saplings.
Reforestation works only if the species suit the soil.

items.definition: số ít và số nhiều viết giống nhau; protect/list as + an endangered species
examples: The river dolphin is now an endangered species.
Trade in endangered species is banned under the convention.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; face/be driven to + extinction
examples: Three frog species face extinction within a decade.
Hunting drove the bird to extinction by 1900.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; establish/visit + a nature reserve
examples: The wetland became a nature reserve in 1998.
A nature reserve protects the last patch of old forest.

items.meaning: hành lang di chuyển cho động vật
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; create/restore + a wildlife corridor
examples: A wildlife corridor links the two forest blocks.
Creating wildlife corridors reduces road deaths.

items.definition: thường ở số nhiều; drain/protect + wetlands
examples: Wetlands store carbon far better than dry grassland.
Half the country's wetlands were drained for rice.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; bleach/protect + a coral reef
examples: Warmer water has bleached most of the coral reef.
Fishing is banned over the inner coral reef.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; enter/disrupt + the food chain
examples: Plastic particles now enter the food chain at every level.
Removing one predator disrupts the whole food chain.

items.definition: số ít và số nhiều giống nhau; introduce/control + an invasive species
examples: An invasive species can empty a lake within years.
Controlling invasive species costs the park service millions.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; act as/destroy + a carbon sink
examples: Peat bogs act as a huge carbon sink.
Draining the marsh destroyed a natural carbon sink.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; create/lack + green space
examples: The district has less green space than any other.
Creating green space lowers summer temperatures.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; improve/invest in + waste management
examples: Waste management swallows a fifth of the city budget.
Better waste management would cut methane sharply.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; send sth to/divert sth from + landfill
examples: Two thirds of household rubbish still goes to landfill.
The scheme diverts food waste from landfill.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; ban/phase out + single-use plastic
examples: Single-use plastic was banned in all state offices.
Supermarkets agreed to phase out single-use plastic bags.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; excessive/reduce + packaging
examples: Excessive packaging accounts for a third of the bin.
The brand reduced packaging by switching to paper.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; home/promote + composting
examples: Home composting removes most food waste from the bin.
The council promotes composting with free bins.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; export/recycle + e-waste
examples: E-waste is the fastest growing waste stream.
Rich countries still export e-waste to poorer ones.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; move towards/build + a circular economy
examples: A circular economy treats waste as raw material.
The strategy moves the industry towards a circular economy.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; introduce/oppose + a carbon tax
examples: A carbon tax makes polluting fuels more expensive.
Industry lobbied hard against the carbon tax.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; tighten/comply with + environmental regulation
examples: Environmental regulation forced the plant to install filters.
Small firms struggle to comply with environmental regulation.

items.meaning: chỉ tiêu cắt giảm khí thải
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; set/miss + an emissions target
examples: The country set an emissions target for 2040.
Most members missed their emissions target by a wide margin.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; sign/withdraw from + a climate agreement
examples: Nearly two hundred states signed the climate agreement.
Withdrawing from the climate agreement cost it credibility.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; assess/minimise + environmental impact
examples: Every large project must assess its environmental impact.
The design minimises environmental impact during construction.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; support/undermine + conservation efforts
examples: Conservation efforts brought the crane population back.
Illegal logging undermines every conservation effort.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; pursue/a model of + sustainable development
examples: Sustainable development balances growth against limits.
The province is held up as a model of sustainable development.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; introduce/enter + a low-emission zone
examples: A low-emission zone cut roadside nitrogen by a fifth.
Older lorries pay to enter the low-emission zone.

items.definition: emit + N; nhân đôi phụ âm: emitting, emitted
examples: Cement kilns emit more carbon than aircraft.
The engine emits almost no particulates.

items.definition: pollute + N; danh từ pollution, pollutant
examples: Runoff from the farm pollutes the stream every spring.
Older boats pollute the harbour badly.

items.definition: conserve + N (energy, water, habitat)
examples: Simple habits conserve a surprising amount of water.
The trust was set up to conserve ancient woodland.

items.definition: preserve + N; preserve sth for + N
examples: The law preserves the dunes for future generations.
Cold water preserved the wreck almost intact.

items.definition: restore + N; restore sth to + N
examples: Volunteers restored the hedgerow over two winters.
The project restored the river to its old course.

items.definition: deplete + N; thường ở dạng bị động
examples: Intensive fishing has depleted every local stock.
Groundwater is being depleted faster than it refills.

items.definition: recycle + N; danh từ recycling
examples: The plant recycles glass into building material.
Only a quarter of plastic is actually recycled.

items.definition: offset + N; dạng quá khứ giữ nguyên offset
examples: Planting trees cannot offset all the flights.
The company offset its emissions by funding solar panels.

items.definition: mitigate + N (risk, impact, damage)
examples: Sea walls mitigate the damage but do not stop it.
Shade trees mitigate the worst of the heat.

items.definition: contaminate + N; thường ở dạng bị động
examples: Lead pipes contaminated the drinking water.
The soil is contaminated to a depth of two metres.

items.definition: degrade + N; cũng tự thân: the plastic degrades slowly
examples: Repeated ploughing degrades the topsoil.
This packaging degrades within six months.

items.definition: absorb + N (carbon, water, heat)
examples: Wetlands absorb floodwater before it reaches the town.
Dark roofs absorb heat all afternoon.

items.definition: harvest + N; cũng là danh từ đếm được
examples: Villagers harvest rainwater through the wet season.
The forest is harvested on a thirty-year cycle.

items.definition: dispose of + N; không tách được
examples: Hospitals must dispose of sharps separately.
Paint cannot be disposed of with household waste.

items.definition: cut down on + N; không tách được
examples: Households were asked to cut down on bottled water.
Cutting down on red meat lowers emissions quickly.

items.definition: phase out + N hoặc phase + N + out; tách được
examples: The city will phase out diesel buses by 2030.
Incandescent bulbs were phased out a decade ago.

items.definition: run out of + N; không tách được
examples: Two districts ran out of water in August.
We are running out of time to limit the rise.

He thinks on his feet better than he writes.

items.definition: call it a day (không đổi hình thức)
examples: They called it a day at eight in the evening.
After thirty years he decided to call it a day.

items.meaning: công việc hành chính giờ cố định
items.definition: work/escape + the nine-to-five
examples: She escaped the nine-to-five by going freelance.
The nine-to-five no longer describes most jobs.

items.definition: be/use sth as + a stepping stone to + N
examples: The internship was a stepping stone to a permanent post.
He used the role as a stepping stone.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; frequent + job hopping
examples: Job hopping is no longer read as disloyalty.
Frequent job hopping raised her salary quickly.

items.meaning: rào cản vô hình trong thăng tiến
items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; hit/break + the glass ceiling
examples: She hit the glass ceiling at middle management.
Quotas were introduced to break the glass ceiling.

items.meaning: khoản tiền lớn khi rời chức
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; receive/a generous + golden handshake
examples: The outgoing chief received a golden handshake.
A golden handshake of that size caused an outcry.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; do/the effects of + shift work
examples: Shift work disrupts sleep for years afterwards.
She has done shift work since she was twenty.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; do/heavy + manual labour
examples: Heavy manual labour wears out the back by fifty.
He did manual labour on building sites for a decade.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; đối lập blue-collar worker
examples: White-collar workers were the first to work from home.
The strike involved both white-collar and manual staff.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; đối lập white-collar worker
examples: Blue-collar workers bore the brunt of automation.
The town was built around blue-collar work.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; enter/a crowded + job market
examples: The job market for translators has shrunk.
She entered a crowded job market in 2009.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; improve/boost + employability
examples: A placement year improves employability more than grades.
The course is sold on employability alone.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; gain/relevant + work experience
examples: She gained work experience in two clinics.
Relevant work experience now counts as much as a degree.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a strong/interview + a candidate
examples: Four candidates were interviewed on the same day.
The strongest candidate withdrew at the last minute.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a successful/reject + an applicant
examples: Nine hundred applicants chased eleven places.
Successful applicants hear within a fortnight.

items.meaning: người hoặc tổ chức sử dụng lao động
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a former/the largest + employer
examples: The port is the largest employer in the province.
Her former employer gave the reference.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a full-time/long-serving + employee
examples: Every employee gets the same travel allowance.
Long-serving employees were offered shares.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a former/a senior + colleague
examples: A colleague covered her shift without being asked.
He still meets former colleagues once a year.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; meet/miss/a tight + deadline
examples: They met every deadline that quarter.
A tight deadline ruins the editing stage.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; set/hit/miss + a target
examples: The team hit its sales target in November.
Unrealistic targets push people to cut corners.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; raise/low + productivity
examples: Productivity rose after the shifts were shortened.
Low productivity here is a management problem.

items.meaning: sản lượng, khối lượng công việc
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; increase/measure + output
examples: Output per worker doubled in five years.
You cannot measure output by hours at a desk.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; have/an annual + appraisal
examples: His annual appraisal lasted twenty minutes.
Appraisals should not be the only feedback anyone gets.

items.meaning: buổi định hướng cho người mới
items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; an induction + day/programme
examples: Induction covers safety before anything else.
The induction day was the only training she received.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; introduce/through + job rotation
examples: Job rotation keeps the night team from stagnating.
The depot introduced job rotation every quarter.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a vague/change + a job title
examples: Her job title changed but the work did not.
Vague job titles make pay comparisons impossible.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; be within/fall outside + sb's remit
examples: Staffing falls outside her remit.
The inquiry has a narrow remit.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; take/share + responsibility for + N
examples: He took responsibility for the error at once.
Responsibility for the rota is shared.

items.meaning: sự chịu trách nhiệm giải trình
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; demand/clear + accountability
examples: Nobody could identify where accountability lay.
The report demands clearer accountability.

items.meaning: quyền tự quyết trong công việc
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; have/give sb + autonomy
examples: Teachers have less autonomy than they did.
The role gives her real autonomy over the budget.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được (nghĩa này); show/use + initiative
examples: She showed initiative on her second day.
Scripts leave no room for initiative.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; a strong + work ethic
examples: He has a strong work ethic and poor boundaries.
A good work ethic is not the same as long hours.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; show/lack + professionalism
examples: The crew showed real professionalism under pressure.
Professionalism is judged in the difficult moments.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; build/present + a portfolio
examples: Designers are hired on their portfolio, not their CV.
She built a portfolio while still studying.

items.meaning: việc mở rộng quan hệ nghề nghiệp
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; a networking + event
examples: Half the posts here are filled through networking.
He dislikes networking but does it anyway.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; join/recognise + a trade union
examples: Two thirds of the staff joined the trade union.
The firm refuses to recognise any trade union.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; through + collective bargaining
examples: Pay is set through collective bargaining.
Collective bargaining covers fewer workers each decade.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; go on/call off + a strike
examples: Drivers went on strike for three days.
The strike was called off at midnight.

items.meaning: hành động đấu tranh của người lao động
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; take/threaten + industrial action
examples: Staff voted to take industrial action.
Industrial action was threatened but never began.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; cross/stand on + a picket line
examples: Nobody crossed the picket line that morning.
She stood on the picket line in the rain.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; raise/a formal + grievance
examples: He raised a formal grievance against his manager.
Grievances are heard by an independent panel.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; take sb to/win at + an employment tribunal
examples: She took the company to an employment tribunal.
The employment tribunal found in his favour.

items.meaning: an toàn và sức khoẻ lao động
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; health and safety + rules/training
examples: Health and safety training is repeated every year.
The site was closed on health and safety grounds.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; carry out/complete + a risk assessment
examples: A risk assessment is carried out before every lift.
The risk assessment had been copied from another site.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; wear/supply + protective equipment
examples: Protective equipment is supplied free.
Nobody on the roof was wearing protective equipment.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a common/treat sth as + an occupational hazard
examples: Deafness is an occupational hazard in the trade.
Late nights are an occupational hazard for reporters.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; protect/a + whistleblower
examples: The whistleblower lost her job within a month.
The law protects whistleblowers in theory only.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; breach/sign + a code of conduct
examples: Every contractor signs the code of conduct.
He breached the code of conduct twice.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; sign/be bound by + a confidentiality agreement
examples: Staff sign a confidentiality agreement on day one.
She is bound by a confidentiality agreement.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; trial/move to + a four-day week
examples: The council trialled a four-day week for a year.
Output held steady under the four-day week.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; adopt/a hybrid working + model
examples: Hybrid working means two days in the office.
They adopted hybrid working permanently.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; introduce + hot-desking
examples: Hot-desking saved rent and cost goodwill.
The floor was redesigned for hot-desking.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; rent/work from + a coworking space
examples: She rents a desk in a coworking space.
Coworking spaces filled the empty shop units.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; be on/a six-month + secondment
examples: He is on secondment to the ministry.
A six-month secondment turned into a transfer.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; take/be on + a sabbatical
examples: She took a sabbatical to finish the book.
Sabbaticals are unpaid after the first term.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; a relocation + package/allowance
examples: The relocation package covers three months of rent.
Relocation was the condition of the promotion.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; apply for/hold + a work permit
examples: He holds a work permit valid for two years.
Applying for a work permit takes four months.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; breach/tighten + labour law
examples: Labour law was tightened after the fire.
The agency breached labour law repeatedly.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; sign/a clause in + an employment contract
examples: Read the employment contract before you sign it.
One clause in the employment contract is unlawful.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; do/an unpaid + trial shift
examples: Unpaid trial shifts are common in kitchens.
She did a trial shift on the Saturday.

items.meaning: người tuyển dụng nhân sự cấp cao
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; be approached by + a headhunter
examples: A headhunter approached her twice that year.
Headhunters work only at the top of the scale.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; register with/use + a recruitment agency
examples: He registered with three recruitment agencies.
The hospital uses a recruitment agency for night cover.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; attend/hold + a job fair
examples: The college holds a job fair every February.
She attended the job fair and left with two interviews.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; sit/pass + an aptitude test
examples: Every applicant sits an aptitude test first.
He passed the aptitude test but failed the interview.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; attend/a one-day + assessment centre
examples: The assessment centre lasts a full day.
Candidates attend an assessment centre in groups of eight.

items.meaning: quá trình hoà nhập người mới
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; improve/an onboarding + process
examples: Onboarding here takes a single afternoon.
Better onboarding cut early resignations by half.

items.meaning: phỏng vấn khi rời công ti
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; conduct/hold + an exit interview
examples: Her exit interview changed nothing.
Exit interviews are held with every leaver.

items.definition: appoint + sb + as/to + N; thường bị động
examples: She was appointed as acting head in July.
They appointed an outsider to the role.

items.definition: redeploy + sb + to + N
examples: Forty staff were redeployed rather than dismissed.
The council redeployed her to the housing team.

items.definition: shadow + sb; cũng là danh từ job shadowing
examples: New recruits shadow a senior nurse for a week.
He shadowed the duty manager every Friday.

items.definition: moonlight as + N
examples: Several drivers moonlight as couriers.
She moonlighted as a tutor for two years.

items.definition: retrain; retrain as + N
examples: He retrained as an electrician at forty.
Miners were promised funds to retrain.

items.definition: headhunt + sb; thường bị động
examples: She was headhunted by a rival firm.
They headhunt engineers straight out of the labs.

items.definition: knuckle down; knuckle down to + N
examples: He knuckled down after the first warning.
The team knuckled down to the backlog.

items.definition: muck in; muck in with + sb
examples: Everyone mucks in when a delivery arrives.
The manager mucked in with the cleaning.

items.definition: step up; step up to + N
examples: Two juniors stepped up while she was ill.
He stepped up to the deputy role overnight.

items.definition: pitch in; pitch in with + N
examples: Neighbours pitched in during the harvest.
Everyone pitched in with the stocktake.

items.definition: bow out; bow out of + N
examples: She bowed out after the merger.
He bowed out of the race for chair.

items.definition: clock off; đối lập clock in
examples: Nobody clocks off before the handover.
They clocked off at three on Fridays.

items.definition: take time off (work); tách được
examples: She took time off after the funeral.
He has taken no time off since January.

items.definition: a salaried + N (post, employee)
examples: A salaried post brought stability at last.
Salaried staff do not record their hours.

items.meaning: làm theo thời vụ, không ổn định
items.definition: casual + N (work, labour, staff)
examples: Casual work pays the fare and little else.
The farm employs casual labour in August.

items.definition: part-time + N; cũng là trạng từ work part-time
examples: Two part-time posts replaced one full job.
She works part-time while studying.

items.definition: full-time + N; cũng là trạng từ work full-time
examples: He returned to full-time work in April.
Only full-time staff join the pension scheme.

items.meaning: bị cho nghỉ vì tinh giản
items.definition: be made redundant
examples: Ninety workers were made redundant.
She was made redundant three weeks before Christmas.

items.definition: be overworked; overworked and underpaid
examples: The ward is overworked and understaffed.
Overworked staff make avoidable errors.

items.definition: be underpaid; badly underpaid
examples: Carers remain badly underpaid.
She was underpaid for a year before noticing.

items.meaning: làm việc trực tiếp với khách hàng
items.definition: a client-facing + N (role, post)
examples: Her first client-facing role terrified her.
Client-facing staff are trained for a fortnight.

items.definition: be/have + a baptism of fire
examples: His first shift was a baptism of fire.
She had a baptism of fire in the complaints team.

items.meaning: bắt tay vào việc hiệu quả ngay
items.definition: hit the ground running
examples: He hit the ground running in his first week.
A good handover lets a successor hit the ground running.

topics.title: Economy & Consumerism
topics.description: Từ vựng về tăng trưởng, tài chính cá nhân và trách nhiệm của người tiêu dùng.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; sustain/stall + economic growth
examples: Economic growth stalled in the second quarter.
The province sustained economic growth for a decade.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được, viết tắt GDP; a share of + gross domestic product
examples: Health spending is eight per cent of gross domestic product.
Gross domestic product tells you nothing about distribution.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; enter/come out of + a recession
examples: The country entered a recession in the spring.
Two quarters of decline define a recession.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; curb/rising + inflation
examples: Inflation reached nine per cent that winter.
The bank raised rates to curb inflation.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; slip into/fear + deflation
examples: Japan slipped into deflation for years.
Falling wages and deflation reinforce each other.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a sharp/weather + an economic downturn
examples: Small shops rarely weather an economic downturn.
The economic downturn hit tourism first.

items.meaning: đà đi lên của kinh tế
items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; a modest/an upturn in + N
examples: The upturn reached the coast two years late.
An upturn in orders saved the foundry.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; the business cycle + peaks/turns
examples: Every business cycle ends in the same complacency.
Housing follows the business cycle closely.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; tighten/loosen + fiscal policy
examples: Fiscal policy was tightened to calm the markets.
Fiscal policy covers both taxation and spending.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; set/ease + monetary policy
examples: The central bank sets monetary policy independently.
Monetary policy was eased three times that year.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; raise/cut + interest rates
examples: Interest rates were cut to half a per cent.
A single rise in interest rates emptied the showrooms.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a favourable/the exchange rate + falls
examples: The exchange rate moved against exporters.
A favourable exchange rate brought in tourists.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a strong/devalue + a currency
examples: The currency lost a fifth of its value.
Three countries share the same currency.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; a sharp + devaluation
examples: Devaluation made imported medicine unaffordable.
The sudden devaluation wiped out savings.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; run/close + a budget deficit
examples: The state has run a budget deficit since 2008.
Closing the budget deficit took eight years.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; service/reduce + the national debt
examples: Servicing the national debt costs more than schools.
The national debt doubled within a decade.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; run/record + a trade surplus
examples: The country runs a trade surplus with its neighbours.
A record trade surplus pushed the currency up.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a widening + trade deficit
examples: The trade deficit widened for six months running.
Cheap imports explain most of the trade deficit.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; cut/increase + public spending
examples: Public spending was cut in every department but defence.
Public spending rises faster than revenue.

items.meaning: chính sách thắt lưng buộc bụng
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; impose/a decade of + austerity
examples: A decade of austerity emptied the youth centres.
Austerity was imposed in the name of the deficit.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; announce/a fiscal + stimulus package
examples: The stimulus package favoured construction.
A second stimulus package was announced in June.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; receive/withdraw + a subsidy
examples: Bus routes survive on a public subsidy.
The fuel subsidy was withdrawn overnight.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; progressive/reform + taxation
examples: Progressive taxation narrows the gap after wages.
Taxation was reformed twice in five years.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; raise/lose + tax revenue
examples: Tax revenue fell with every factory closure.
The levy raised modest tax revenue.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; prosecute sb for + tax evasion
examples: Two directors were prosecuted for tax evasion.
Tax evasion is a crime; avoidance is not.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; aggressive/clamp down on + tax avoidance
examples: Aggressive tax avoidance is legal and corrosive.
Governments clamp down on tax avoidance slowly.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; impose/lift + a tariff on + N
examples: A tariff was imposed on imported steel.
Tariffs on grain were lifted in March.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; set/scrap + an import quota
examples: An import quota protected local mills.
The import quota was scrapped under the treaty.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; the law of + supply and demand
examples: Rents are set by supply and demand, not by need.
Supply and demand explain the shortage only partly.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; gain/lose + market share
examples: The firm lost market share to cheaper rivals.
Two companies hold ninety per cent of the market share.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được (nghĩa này); face/stifle + competition
examples: Local bakers face competition from supermarkets.
Patents stifle competition for twenty years.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; hold/break up + a monopoly
examples: One operator held a monopoly on the route.
Regulators broke up the monopoly in 1998.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; form/expose + a cartel
examples: Six suppliers had formed a cartel.
The cartel fixed prices for eleven years.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; financial + deregulation
examples: Financial deregulation preceded the crash.
Deregulation lowered fares and safety standards alike.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; the privatisation of + N
examples: The privatisation of water remains contested.
Privatisation raised cash and lost control.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; call for + nationalisation
examples: Unions called for the nationalisation of the grid.
Nationalisation followed the second bailout.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; reform/a loss-making + state-owned enterprise
examples: Loss-making state-owned enterprises were merged.
The port is still a state-owned enterprise.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; in/work in + the private sector
examples: Most new jobs are in the private sector.
She moved to the private sector for the pay.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; public sector + pay/workers
examples: Public sector pay was frozen for four years.
The public sector employs a fifth of the workforce.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; consumer spending + rises/weakens
examples: Consumer spending weakened before the layoffs began.
Christmas consumer spending beat every forecast.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; restore/dent + consumer confidence
examples: Consumer confidence fell to a ten-year low.
Nothing dents consumer confidence like a rate rise.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; lose/erode + purchasing power
examples: Wages rose but purchasing power fell.
Inflation eroded the purchasing power of pensions.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; the rising + cost of living
examples: The rising cost of living emptied the restaurants.
Cost of living differs hugely between the two cities.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; the consumer + price index
examples: The consumer price index rose for the ninth month.
Housing is weighted oddly in the price index.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; start/be locked in + a price war
examples: Two airlines were locked in a price war.
The price war destroyed both margins.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a thin/squeeze + a profit margin
examples: Profit margins in grocery are famously thin.
Energy costs squeezed the profit margin to nothing.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; generate/annual + revenue
examples: Advertising generates most of the revenue.
Annual revenue passed a billion in 2021.

items.definition: danh từ số nhiều; cut/high + overheads
examples: High overheads closed the city branch.
Working from home cut overheads sharply.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; reach/pass + the break-even point
examples: The service reached its break-even point in year three.
They passed the break-even point before the grant ended.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; file for/face + bankruptcy
examples: The chain filed for bankruptcy in August.
Two suppliers face bankruptcy because of the delay.

items.meaning: tình trạng mất khả năng trả nợ
items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; trading while + insolvent
examples: The firm traded for months in clear insolvency.
Insolvency proceedings began in October.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; go into + liquidation
examples: The builder went into liquidation owing wages.
Liquidation returned nine pence in the pound.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; block/approve + a merger
examples: Regulators blocked the merger on competition grounds.
The merger created the largest carrier in the region.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; complete/fund + an acquisition
examples: The acquisition was completed in March.
Debt funded the whole acquisition.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; launch/reject + a takeover bid
examples: The board rejected a hostile takeover bid.
A second takeover bid arrived within weeks.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; run/support + a small business
examples: Small businesses carry the whole high street.
She has run a small business since 2011.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; raise/attract + venture capital
examples: They raised venture capital on a slide deck.
Venture capital avoids anything with a long payback.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a major/reward + shareholders
