examples: The editorial line shifted after the takeover.
Reporters are not told the editorial line; they absorb it.

items.meaning: việc huấn luyện trả lời báo chí
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; receive/undergo + media training
examples: Every minister receives media training before a bulletin.
Media training teaches people how to say nothing warmly.

items.meaning: câu nói ngắn dễ phát lại
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a memorable + sound bite
examples: The whole speech survived as one sound bite.
Policy is now written to produce sound bites.

items.definition: make headlines
examples: The verdict made headlines across the region.
A small charity made headlines for a week.

items.definition: be/put sb + in the limelight
examples: The case put the department in the limelight.
She has been in the limelight since the documentary.

items.definition: become/turn into + a media circus
examples: The trial turned into a media circus.
A media circus outside the school helped nobody.

items.definition: run/be the target of + a smear campaign
examples: A smear campaign followed her evidence.
They ran a smear campaign through anonymous accounts.

items.meaning: quyền lực thứ tư của báo chí
items.definition: the fourth estate + holds power to account
examples: The fourth estate works only while somebody pays for reporters.
They invoked the fourth estate to defend the intrusion.

items.definition: be/turn out to be + a storm in a teacup
examples: The row turned out to be a storm in a teacup.
What looked like a storm in a teacup ended a career.

items.meaning: lặng lẽ không bị chú ý
items.definition: stay/slip + under the radar
examples: The decision slipped under the radar completely.
Two closures stayed under the radar until March.

items.definition: in/be tried in + the court of public opinion
examples: He was convicted in the court of public opinion first.
The court of public opinion hears no defence.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; extensive/blanket + news coverage
examples: News coverage of the flood lasted two days.
Blanket news coverage made the story feel larger than it was.

items.definition: danh từ số nhiều; the + news values + of an outlet
examples: News values decide which deaths are reported.
The news values of the paper changed with the owner.

items.meaning: việc định hướng chủ đề dư luận
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; agenda setting + by the press
examples: Agenda setting happens before any article is written.
Agenda setting by two papers shaped the whole debate.

items.meaning: việc chọn lọc thông tin trước khi công bố
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; editorial + gatekeeping
examples: Editorial gatekeeping kept rumour out of print.
Gatekeeping collapsed once anyone could publish.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; the + letters page + carries
examples: The letters page carried nine replies that week.
She read the letters page before the news.

items.definition: danh từ số nhiều; place/lose + classified ads
examples: Classified ads paid for local reporting for a century.
Classified ads moved online and the papers closed.

items.meaning: bài viết về người vừa mất
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; write/an + obituary
examples: The obituary ran to half a page.
Obituaries are written years before they are needed.

items.meaning: bản tin dự báo thời tiết
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; give/the + weather forecast
examples: The weather forecast follows the bulletin.
A wrong weather forecast is remembered longer than any report.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; in/an emptying + newsroom
examples: The newsroom has nine staff where it once had forty.
Decisions are made in the newsroom at ten each morning.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; run/sell + a printing press
examples: The printing press was sold for scrap.
Their own printing press ran until 2009.

items.meaning: người phụ trách thông tin báo chí
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + press officer + handles
examples: The press officer returned every call but answered nothing.
Four press officers serve one department.

items.meaning: nhóm phóng viên vây đưa tin
items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; the + press pack + waits
examples: The press pack waited outside the gate for days.
He walked through the press pack without a word.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; the + picture desk + chooses
examples: The picture desk chose the least flattering frame.
Both picture desks were closed in the merger.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; in/a + public interest + defence
examples: They claimed a public interest defence for the recording.
Public interest is not the same as what interests the public.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + public figure + expects scrutiny
examples: A public figure accepts scrutiny of their work, not their family.
She became a public figure against her will.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; print/thrive on + celebrity gossip
examples: Celebrity gossip pays for the news pages.
Two sections of celebrity gossip replaced the foreign desk.

items.meaning: nhóm nhiếp ảnh săn người nổi tiếng
items.definition: danh từ số nhiều; be chased by + the paparazzi
examples: The paparazzi waited outside the clinic.
Paparazzi photographs still command the highest fees.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + press photographer + covers
examples: One press photographer covered the whole county.
Press photographers were kept behind a barrier.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; criticise + tabloid journalism
examples: Tabloid journalism broke the hacking story as well.
Tabloid journalism is cheaper and better read.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; fund/a decline in + investigative journalism
examples: Investigative journalism takes months and sells no advertising.
A trust now funds investigative journalism here.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; listen to/cut + local radio
examples: Local radio carried the flood warnings first.
Local radio lost its own newsroom in 2018.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; run/a community + radio station
examples: The community radio station broadcasts in two languages.
A single radio station serves the whole valley.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; watch sth on + a catch-up service
examples: Most of the audience watched on the catch-up service.
The catch-up service keeps programmes for thirty days.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + streaming platform + commissions
examples: The streaming platform commissioned the second series.
Two streaming platforms outbid every broadcaster.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; scroll/a + news feed
examples: The news feed showed the same story nine times.
Her news feed never mentioned the strike at all.

items.meaning: chủ đề đang được bàn nhiều
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; become + a trending topic
examples: The closure became a trending topic for an afternoon.
A trending topic is not evidence of public concern.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; moderate/close + reader comments
examples: Reader comments were closed on that article.
Moderating reader comments costs more than writing the piece.

items.meaning: kẻ cố tình gây hấn trên mạng
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; block/a + troll
examples: Trolls targeted every woman on the panel.
One troll ran nine accounts.

items.meaning: hành vi lăng mạ trên mạng
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; report/suffer + online abuse
examples: Online abuse drove two reporters off the platform.
She reported the online abuse and heard nothing back.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; content + moderation
examples: Content moderation is outsourced to another continent.
Moderation rules were rewritten after the inquiry.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; add/a + content warning
examples: A content warning was added before the footage.
Content warnings are mocked until they are needed.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; receive/uphold + a viewer complaint
examples: Nine hundred viewer complaints followed the sketch.
The regulator upheld two viewer complaints.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; lose/a falling + audience share
examples: Audience share fell below ten per cent.
They bought the rights to protect their audience share.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; concentrated + media ownership
examples: Media ownership is concentrated in four companies.
Rules on media ownership were relaxed in 2003.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + media conglomerate + owns
examples: One media conglomerate owns the paper and the channel.
Media conglomerates sell the advertising as a package.

items.meaning: ông chủ báo có quyền lực lớn
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + press baron + dictates
examples: The press baron dictated the editorial line by telephone.
Press barons outlasted most of the politicians they attacked.

items.meaning: sự độc lập về biên tập
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; guarantee/lose + editorial independence
examples: Editorial independence was guaranteed in writing and ignored.
Without editorial independence a newsroom is a press office.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; breach/sign up to + a code of practice
examples: The code of practice forbids payment to witnesses.
They breached the code of practice on two counts.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; assert/breach + the right to privacy
examples: The court weighed the right to privacy against the public interest.
Her right to privacy ended at the hospital door, they argued.

items.definition: hype + N; thường bị động
examples: The launch was hyped for a month.
They hyped a routine appointment into a crisis.

items.definition: disclose + N + to + sb; thường bị động
examples: The report was disclosed to two papers.
Nobody disclosed the payments until the audit.

items.meaning: thông tin riêng cho báo chí
items.definition: brief + sb + on/about + N
examples: Advisers briefed four papers that evening.
She briefed the press before telling her own department.

items.meaning: đăng nổi bật trên trang nhất
items.definition: splash + N + across/on + N
examples: They splashed the photograph across the front page.
The story was splashed on every tabloid.

items.meaning: xác nhận bằng nguồn độc lập
items.definition: corroborate + N; thường bị động
examples: The footage could not be corroborated.
Two departments corroborated the figure.

items.definition: attribute + N + to + sb; thường bị động
examples: The quote was attributed to an unnamed official.
They attributed the claim to a single document.

items.definition: circulate; circulate among + N
examples: The recording circulated for a week before anyone checked it.
Rumours circulated among staff before the announcement.

items.definition: amplify + N; thường bị động
examples: The claim was amplified by nine large accounts.
Repeating a lie to correct it amplifies it.

items.definition: debunk + N; thường bị động
examples: The theory was debunked in the same week.
They debunked the figure line by line.

items.definition: an in-depth + N (report, interview)
examples: An in-depth report ran across three pages.
In-depth interviews take a day to prepare.

items.definition: a hard-hitting + N (documentary, editorial)
examples: A hard-hitting documentary forced the resignation.
The editorial was hard-hitting and carefully lawyered.

items.definition: a one-sided + N (account, debate)
examples: The coverage was one-sided for a fortnight.
A one-sided account is not the same as a lie.

items.definition: inflammatory + N (language, headline)
examples: Inflammatory language on the front page preceded the violence.
The regulator called the headline inflammatory.

items.definition: intrusive + N (coverage, photography)
examples: Intrusive coverage followed the family to the funeral.
The photography was intrusive by any standard.

items.definition: a misleading + N (headline, figure)
examples: The headline was accurate and thoroughly misleading.
Two misleading graphs were withdrawn.

items.definition: a widely read + N (column, blog)
examples: The column is widely read inside government.
A widely read blog broke the story first.

items.definition: an award-winning + N (series, reporter)
examples: An award-winning series was cancelled anyway.
Their award-winning reporter left for a charity.

items.definition: a pre-recorded + N (interview, segment)
examples: The interview was pre-recorded and heavily cut.
A pre-recorded message answered every question.

items.definition: a prime-time + N (slot, audience)
examples: The debate was given a prime-time slot.
A prime-time audience sees nine advertisements an hour.

items.meaning: được bán lại cho nhiều nơi đăng
items.definition: a syndicated + N (column, feature)
examples: The syndicated column appears in forty papers.
Syndicated features replaced local writing.

items.meaning: có tính xúc phạm danh dự
items.definition: a defamatory + N (claim, article)
examples: Two sentences were found to be defamatory.
They removed the defamatory paragraph and kept the rest.

items.definition: put out + N hoặc put + N + out; tách được
examples: The department put out a statement at midnight.
They put a correction out on page nineteen.

items.definition: run with + N; không tách được
examples: Two papers ran with the unverified version.
They ran with the headline and apologised later.

items.definition: dig up + N hoặc dig + N + up; tách được
examples: Reporters dug up a letter from 1994.
They dug his old interviews up within hours.

items.definition: follow up + N hoặc follow + N + up; tách được
examples: Nobody followed up the first complaint.
She followed the lead up for three months.

items.meaning: nêu tên chỉ trích công khai
items.definition: call out + N hoặc call + N + out; tách được
examples: Readers called out the error within minutes.
She called the broadcaster out on air.

items.meaning: giữ nguyên quan điểm đã nêu
items.definition: stand by + N; không tách được
examples: The editor stood by the story for a year.
They stood by every word of the headline.

items.definition: rake up + N hoặc rake + N + up; tách được
examples: The piece raked up a case from his twenties.
They raked the old dispute up again.

items.definition: hold back + N hoặc hold + N + back; tách được
examples: The paper held back the name for legal reasons.
They held the pictures back until the trial ended.

items.definition: spread like wildfire
examples: The clip spread like wildfire before anyone checked the date.
The rumour spread like wildfire through the whole estate.

items.definition: be/on + a slow news day
examples: The story ran because it was a slow news day.
On a slow news day a planning notice becomes a scandal.

items.definition: speak/say sth + off the cuff
examples: The remark was off the cuff and cost him the post.
She answered off the cuff and was quoted for weeks.

items.definition: read between the lines
examples: Read between the lines and the resignation was already agreed.
Readers were left to read between the lines.

items.definition: a campaign of + mud-slinging
examples: The contest descended into mud-slinging.
Mud-slinging between the two camps filled the airtime.

items.meaning: là nơi đầu tiên đưa tin
items.definition: break the news + about/of + N
examples: A weekly paper broke the news of the closure.
They broke the news an hour before the official statement.

items.meaning: đã công khai cho mọi người
items.definition: be/put sth + in the public domain
examples: The documents were already in the public domain.
Putting the figures in the public domain ended the argument.

topics.title: Culture & Heritage
topics.description: Từ vựng về di sản, bản sắc địa phương và hoạt động trao đổi văn hoá.

items.definition: danh từ số nhiều; fund/work in + the arts
examples: Funding for the arts fell faster than for sport.
She has worked in the arts since leaving college.

items.meaning: nghệ thuật tạo hình hàn lâm
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; study/a + fine art + degree
examples: He studied fine art for four years and now paints signs.
Fine art and craft were taught in separate buildings.

items.definition: danh từ số nhiều; the + visual arts + attract
examples: The visual arts attract the largest audiences and the smallest grants.
Her training was in the visual arts, not in design.

items.definition: danh từ số nhiều; study/a + performing arts + centre
examples: The performing arts centre opened without an endowment.
Performing arts courses were cut in nine colleges.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; hold/mount + an exhibition
examples: The exhibition toured four cities.
They mounted an exhibition of local photographs.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a public/a commercial + gallery
examples: The public gallery is free on Wednesdays.
Two commercial galleries closed in the same year.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; visit/endow + a museum
examples: The museum holds nine thousand objects and shows two hundred.
A local museum tells a story no national one can.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; build/donate + a collection
examples: The collection was donated on condition it stayed together.
He built the collection over fifty years.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + curator + selects
examples: The curator chose objects nobody expected.
Two curators share the whole department.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; display/return + an artefact
examples: The artefact was returned to its country of origin.
Nine artefacts were lost in transit.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; carve/a bronze + sculpture
examples: The sculpture stood in the square for forty years.
She works in sculpture rather than paint.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; hang/restore + a painting
examples: The painting hung in a corridor for decades.
Restoring the painting revealed a second figure.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; paint/sit for + a portrait
examples: She sat for the portrait four times.
The portrait is the only likeness that survives.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + landscape painting + of + N
examples: The landscape painting shows the valley before the reservoir.
Landscape painting went out of fashion and came back.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; paint/a + still life
examples: He painted the same still life for a year.
A still life teaches patience more than talent.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; understand/dislike + abstract art
examples: Abstract art emptied the galleries and filled the arguments.
She came to abstract art late.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; create/a site-specific + installation
examples: The installation filled the whole turbine hall.
A site-specific installation cannot be sold on.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; collect/study + folk art
examples: Folk art was collected only when it had almost disappeared.
Folk art here means painted carts and embroidered cloth.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; protect/destroy + cultural heritage
examples: Cultural heritage was destroyed deliberately during the war.
Protecting cultural heritage costs money every year, not once.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; safeguard + intangible heritage
examples: Songs and crafts count as intangible heritage.
Intangible heritage disappears when the last speaker dies.

items.meaning: di sản thế giới được công nhận
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; designate + a world heritage site
examples: The valley became a world heritage site in 2001.
World heritage site status brought visitors and restrictions.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; erect/preserve + a monument
examples: The monument lists nine hundred names.
A monument was erected where the chapel stood.

items.definition: danh từ số nhiều; the + ruins of + N
examples: The ruins of the abbey draw visitors all summer.
Only the ruins of the bath house remain.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; fund/a careful + restoration
examples: The restoration took eleven years.
A careless restoration destroys more than neglect.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a repertory/go to + the theatre
examples: The theatre seats four hundred and loses money.
She goes to the theatre twice a month.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + playwright + writes
examples: The playwright rewrote the ending during rehearsals.
Two playwrights were commissioned for the season.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; study/a television + drama
examples: The drama was staged in a converted warehouse.
Drama classes kept half the year group in school.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a dress/hold + a rehearsal
examples: The dress rehearsal was open to the public.
Nine rehearsals in a cold hall preceded the premiere.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; stage/sing in + an opera
examples: The opera was sung in translation.
Opera carries a reputation for grandeur it rarely deserves.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; dance in/a + ballet
examples: The ballet company tours every spring.
She danced in the ballet for nine seasons.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; conduct/join + an orchestra
examples: The orchestra lost its subsidy and its conductor.
A youth orchestra rehearses in the same hall.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; compose/perform + a symphony
examples: The symphony was performed twice in one week.
He left the symphony unfinished.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; give/attend + a concert
examples: The concert sold out in an afternoon.
They give a free concert every midsummer.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; give/a piano + recital
examples: Her first recital was in a village church.
The recital lasted an hour without an interval.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; sing in/join + a choir
examples: The choir has sung in that church since 1890.
He joined the choir to meet people.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; play/collect + folk music
examples: Folk music survived in two valleys and nowhere else.
She collects folk music from the older singers.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; listen to/study + classical music
examples: Classical music lost its evening slot on the station.
Classical music is cheap to record and expensive to perform.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; host/play + live music
examples: Three pubs still host live music.
Live music returned to the square in June.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; hold/a literary + festival
examples: The festival fills every spare room in town.
A literary festival grew out of one bookshop.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a street + carnival
examples: The carnival has run since 1964.
Nine thousand people walk in the carnival.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; hold/watch + a parade
examples: The parade takes two hours to pass.
A parade of lanterns closes the festival.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; study/translate + literature
examples: The literature of the period is almost all anonymous.
She teaches literature in two languages.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + novelist + publishes
examples: The novelist wrote nine books and sold two.
A local novelist set three books in the town.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; write/read + poetry
examples: Poetry sells badly and lasts longest.
He writes poetry and shows nobody.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; plain/write + prose
examples: Her prose is plain and exact.
He wrote prose for a living and poetry for himself.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; read/write + fiction
examples: Fiction outsells everything else in the library.
She stopped writing fiction after the inquiry.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; read/publish + non-fiction
examples: Non-fiction accounts for most of their list.
He moved from fiction to non-fiction in his fifties.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; write/a collection of + short stories
examples: The short story runs to nine pages.
Her collection of short stories was reprinted twice.

items.meaning: sách viết về đời người khác
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; write/an authorised + biography
examples: The biography relied on nine boxes of letters.
An authorised biography tells you what the family allowed.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; write/publish + an autobiography
examples: The autobiography stops at nineteen forty-five.
She wrote her autobiography at eighty-two.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; write/a + memoir + of + N
examples: The memoir describes one winter in detail.
His memoir of the strike is the only account from inside.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; compile/appear in + an anthology
examples: Her poem appears in every anthology of the period.
They compiled an anthology of local writing.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; write/study + literary criticism
examples: Literary criticism has its own impenetrable vocabulary.
He turned to literary criticism when the novels stopped.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; a new/read sth in + translation
examples: The new translation changed how the book is read.
Most readers meet the poem only in translation.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; become/an international + bestseller
examples: The book became a bestseller nine years after publication.
A bestseller funds four books that are not.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; an independent/go to + the cinema
examples: The independent cinema survives on a members' scheme.
National cinema here means four films a year.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; the + film industry + employs
examples: The film industry employs more electricians than actors.
Tax relief rebuilt the film industry in a decade.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; make/a + feature film
examples: Her first feature film was shot in nine days.
A feature film needs money long before it needs a script.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; write/adapt + a screenplay
examples: The screenplay went through eleven drafts.
He adapted the screenplay from his own novel.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a film/the + director + casts
examples: The director cast unknown actors deliberately.
Two directors left the project before filming.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; assemble/the + cast + rehearses
examples: The cast rehearsed for three weeks.
A cast of nine plays forty parts.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; the + box office + takes
examples: The film did badly at the box office and well afterwards.
Box office takings paid for the next production.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a summer + blockbuster
examples: The blockbuster filled every screen for a month.
One blockbuster subsidises nine smaller films.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; an + art-house film + screens
