items.meaning: chính thức tham gia hiệp ước
items.definition: accede to + N
examples: The country acceded to the convention in 1998.
Two states acceded to the treaty after the amendment.

items.definition: withdraw from + N; quá khứ withdrew, withdrawn
examples: They withdrew from the agreement after the election.
She withdrew from the talks on the second day.

items.definition: impose + N + on + N; thường bị động
examples: Conditions were imposed on every loan.
They imposed a duty of twenty per cent.

items.definition: comply with + N
examples: Only four firms complied with the labelling rules.
They complied with the letter of the standard.

items.definition: bilateral + N (talks, deal)
examples: Bilateral talks resumed after nine months.
A bilateral deal was easier than a treaty.

items.definition: multilateral + N (institution, process)
examples: Multilateral institutions move at the speed of their slowest member.
The multilateral process collapsed and the bilateral deals multiplied.

items.definition: unilateral + N (action, decision)
examples: The unilateral decision angered every partner.
Unilateral action rarely survives the next government.

items.definition: overseas + N (market, branch, worker)
examples: Overseas markets took nine tenths of the output.
The overseas branch outgrew the parent company.

items.definition: offshore + N (account, operation)
examples: The offshore operation employs nobody locally.
Offshore structures hid the real owner for years.

items.definition: an outward-looking + N (economy, policy)
examples: An outward-looking economy still needs a domestic market.
The city has been outward-looking since the first harbour.

items.definition: an insular + N (attitude, policy)
examples: An insular attitude cost the region two decades.
The industry became insular and then obsolete.

items.definition: wide-ranging + N (reform, consequences)
examples: The ruling had wide-ranging consequences for every importer.
Wide-ranging reform was announced and partly delivered.

items.meaning: cùng có lợi hoặc cùng chiều
items.definition: mutual + N (benefit, recognition)
examples: Mutual recognition of qualifications took nine years.
The deal was signed for mutual benefit and read differently in each capital.

items.definition: a binding + N (commitment, target)
examples: The targets are binding only on those who ratified.
A binding commitment was watered down to a pledge.

items.definition: sign up to + N; không tách được
examples: Forty states signed up to the convention.
They signed up to the targets and missed every one.

items.definition: back out of + N; không tách được
examples: One partner backed out of the venture late.
They backed out of the agreement after the audit.

items.definition: follow suit; không có tân ngữ
examples: Two neighbours followed suit within a month.
When one bank cut rates the rest followed suit.

items.meaning: tách ra bán hoặc chuyển giao
items.definition: hive off + N hoặc hive + N + off; tách được
examples: The shipping arm was hived off to a foreign buyer.
They hived the loss-making division off in 2014.

items.definition: tap into + N; không tách được
examples: The brand tapped into a market nobody had served.
They tapped into the diaspora for the first investment.

items.definition: lock in + N hoặc lock + N + in; tách được
examples: The contract locks in the price for nine years.
They were locked in to a single supplier.

items.definition: hollow out + N hoặc hollow + N + out; tách được
examples: Offshoring hollowed out the whole engineering base.
The town was hollowed out one closure at a time.

items.meaning: tình huống đôi bên đều lợi
items.definition: be/create + a win-win situation
examples: The exchange was presented as a win-win situation.
A win-win situation usually hides who is counting.

items.definition: swim against the tide
examples: The cooperative swam against the tide for twenty years.
Keeping production local meant swimming against the tide.

items.definition: be + a two-way street
examples: Cultural exchange is a two-way street in theory.
Investment is a two-way street now; it was not in 1990.

items.meaning: có lợi và có hại cho cả hai
items.definition: cut both ways
examples: Open borders cut both ways for small producers.
The argument about standards cuts both ways.

items.definition: have/want + the best of both worlds
examples: They wanted the best of both worlds and signed nothing.
The arrangement gave the port the best of both worlds.

items.definition: close the gap + between + N
examples: Two decades of schooling closed the gap in literacy.
Nothing in the plan closes the gap between the regions.

items.definition: hold all the cards
examples: The buyer holds all the cards in that negotiation.
Whoever controls the strait holds all the cards.

topics.title: Science & Research
topics.description: Từ vựng về nghiên cứu khoa học, bằng chứng và trách nhiệm trong học thuật.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; follow/apply + the scientific method
examples: The scientific method is a habit of doubting your own result.
They applied the scientific method to a question nobody had framed.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được, số nhiều hypotheses; form/test + a hypothesis
examples: The hypothesis survived nine rounds of testing.
She formed a hypothesis from one odd reading.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; propose/overturn + a theory
examples: The theory explained everything except the timing.
One measurement overturned a theory held for a century.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; run/design + an experiment
examples: The experiment ran for eleven months.
A badly designed experiment wastes a year.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + control group + receives
examples: The control group received no treatment at all.
Without a control group the result means little.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; isolate/a confounding + variable
examples: One variable had been left uncontrolled.
They isolated each variable in turn.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a small/increase + the sample size
examples: The sample size was nine, which explains everything.
They increased the sample size and the effect disappeared.

items.definition: danh từ số nhiều; publish/replicate + the findings
examples: The findings were published two years after the work.
Nobody has replicated the findings since.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; gather/weigh + evidence
examples: The evidence points one way and the funding another.
They gathered evidence for nine field seasons.

items.meaning: nhận xét của người bình duyệt
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; receive/a + referee report
examples: The referee report caught the arithmetic error.
Two referee reports contradicted each other.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; attempt + replication
examples: Replication is the least funded and most necessary work.
Two attempts at replication failed.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; write/submit + a research paper
examples: The research paper runs to nine pages and four years of work.
They submitted the research paper to three journals.

items.meaning: bài trong tạp chí chuyên ngành
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; publish/cite + a journal article
examples: The journal article is behind a paywall nobody local can pass.
She cited the same journal article in every lecture.

items.meaning: chỉ số ảnh hưởng của tạp chí
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a high + impact factor
examples: The journal has a high impact factor and a narrow readership.
Impact factor measures the journal, not the paper.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; work in/equip + a laboratory
examples: The laboratory had one working fume cupboard.
She worked in the same laboratory for thirty years.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; carry out/three seasons of + fieldwork
examples: Fieldwork took three summers and produced one table.
Fieldwork in winter was abandoned after the first attempt.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; collect/label + a specimen
examples: Each specimen was labelled with the date and depth.
Nine thousand specimens sit in unopened drawers.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; use/under + a microscope
examples: Under the microscope the structure is obvious.
The microscope was donated by a retired dentist.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; build/point + a telescope
examples: The telescope sees further than anything built before it.
They pointed the telescope at an empty patch of sky.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; set up/dismantle + apparatus
examples: The apparatus took two days to set up.
Half the apparatus was built in the workshop.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; take/repeat + a measurement
examples: Every measurement was repeated three times.
One measurement contradicted the whole series.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; check/regular + calibration
examples: The calibration had drifted over the winter.
Regular calibration is dull and non-negotiable.

items.meaning: độ chính xác so với giá trị thật
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; improve/check + accuracy
examples: Accuracy matters more than resolution here.
They improved accuracy by cooling the detector.

items.meaning: độ chụm của kết quả đo
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; high/improve + precision
examples: High precision with poor accuracy fools everyone.
Precision improved tenfold with the new instrument.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + margin of error + of + số liệu
examples: The margin of error is wider than the effect claimed.
They quoted the figure without any margin of error.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; reach/claim + statistical significance
examples: The result never reached statistical significance.
Statistical significance is not the same as importance.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; find/a strong + correlation
examples: They found a strong correlation and no mechanism.
The correlation held in four countries out of nine.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; establish/infer + causation
examples: Correlation was clear; causation was not.
Establishing causation required a controlled trial.

items.meaning: độ chệch, thiên lệch trong nghiên cứu
items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; selection/publication + bias
examples: Publication bias hides every negative result.
Selection bias explained most of the difference.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a major/achieve + a breakthrough
examples: The breakthrough came from a failed experiment.
They achieved the breakthrough with borrowed equipment.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; make/announce + a discovery
examples: The discovery was made by a student checking old data.
They announced the discovery before anyone had checked it.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; an + invention + transforms
examples: The invention was ignored for forty years.
One invention changed how the whole trade worked.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; secure/cut + research funding
examples: Research funding goes to safe questions.
Research funding was cut in the middle of the project.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; found/a + research institute
examples: The research institute employs ninety people.
A research institute was founded on one private legacy.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; an early-career + researcher
examples: Early-career researchers hold the shortest contracts.
Two researchers shared one microscope.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + scientist + argues/publishes
examples: Nine scientists signed the letter.
The scientist refused to overstate the result.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a theoretical + physicist
examples: A theoretical physicist predicted the particle in 1964.
Two physicists shared the prize.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; an industrial + chemist
examples: An industrial chemist solved the problem in a week.
The chemist kept nine notebooks of failures.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a marine/a + biologist + studies
examples: The biologist counted the same colony for thirty years.
Two biologists disagreed about the classification.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + geneticist + sequences
examples: The geneticist traced the line back nine generations.
Geneticists revised the family tree entirely.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; an amateur + astronomer
examples: An amateur astronomer spotted the comet first.
Astronomers booked the telescope two years ahead.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + research field + emerges
examples: The research field barely existed in 1950.
Two research fields use the same word for different things.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; study/particle + physics
examples: Particle physics needs machines the size of a town.
She teaches physics to pupils who will never use it.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; organic/study + chemistry
examples: Organic chemistry defeated half the year group.
The chemistry of the soil explains the whole harvest.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; marine/study + biology
examples: Biology here was taught from one shelf of textbooks.
Biology was the last subject to go quantitative.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; study/human + genetics
examples: Genetics answered a question history could not.
Human genetics advanced faster than the ethics did.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; sequence/the human + genome
examples: The genome was sequenced in thirteen years and now takes a day.
Sequencing one genome cost a billion and now costs little.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + gene + codes for + N
examples: The gene codes for a single protein.
Nine genes influence the same trait.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + chromosome + carries
examples: Each chromosome carries thousands of genes.
The extra chromosome explains the condition.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + cell + divides
examples: The cell divides every twenty hours.
Nine cells were enough to start the culture.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + molecule + binds
examples: The molecule binds to one site only.
They modelled the molecule before synthesising it.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; an + atom + consists of + N
examples: The atom is mostly empty space.
They counted atoms one layer at a time.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; detect/a subatomic + particle
examples: The particle existed for a fraction of a second.
Detecting the particle took nine years.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a chemical/an + element + occurs
examples: The element occurs naturally in two minerals.
Nine elements make up most of the crust.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a chemical + compound + forms
examples: The compound breaks down in sunlight.
They synthesised a compound nobody had made before.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + chemical reaction + occurs
examples: The chemical reaction releases heat quickly.
One chemical reaction explains the whole smell.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; act as/a + catalyst
examples: The catalyst speeds the reaction without being consumed.
A cheaper catalyst made the process viable.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; an + enzyme + breaks down + N
examples: The enzyme breaks down starch in minutes.
Without the enzyme nothing happens at that temperature.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + microbe + lives/thrives
examples: The microbe lives in water near boiling point.
Microbes in the gut outnumber the body's own cells.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; the + evolution of + N
examples: The evolution of flight happened at least four times.
Evolution explains the structure and not the beauty.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; by + natural selection
examples: Resistance spread by natural selection within three seasons.
Natural selection acts on what already varies.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; find/date + a fossil
examples: The fossil was found in a road cutting.
Dating the fossil changed the whole sequence.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; the + geology of + N
examples: The geology of the valley explains where the springs are.
Geology decided where every village was built.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; plate tectonics + explains
examples: Plate tectonics explains the whole mountain chain.
Plate tectonics was resisted for forty years.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; monitor/record + seismic activity
examples: Seismic activity was recorded nine kilometres down.
They monitor seismic activity from three stations.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; study/radio + astronomy
examples: Radio astronomy began with surplus wartime equipment.
Astronomy is the oldest quantitative science.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a spiral/a + galaxy + contains
examples: The galaxy contains two hundred billion stars.
Nine galaxies appear in that single image.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; the + solar system + formed
examples: The solar system formed from one collapsing cloud.
Nothing in the solar system is as still as it looks.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; enter/a low-earth + orbit
examples: The satellite entered a low-earth orbit.
Its orbit decays by a kilometre a year.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; launch/a + space probe
examples: The space probe is still transmitting after forty years.
A space probe reached the comet in 2014.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; dock at/a + space station
examples: The space station is crewed continuously.
Nine countries use the same space station.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; train/an + astronaut
examples: The astronaut spent eleven months in orbit.
Astronauts train for nine years before a first flight.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; launch/a + spacecraft
examples: The spacecraft used the planet's gravity to turn.
Two spacecraft were lost on the same mission.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; track/an + asteroid + passes
examples: The asteroid passed closer than the moon.
They track nine thousand asteroids continuously.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; detect/a + black hole
examples: A black hole sits at the centre of most galaxies.
They photographed the shadow of a black hole.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; be + số + light years + away
examples: The star is nine hundred light years away.
A light year measures distance, not time.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; the force of + gravity
examples: Gravity is the weakest force and the one that shapes everything.
Low gravity weakens bone within weeks.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; build/an + observatory
examples: The observatory was built above the cloud layer.
An observatory needs darkness more than money.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; fund + space exploration
examples: Space exploration returned more to medicine than to mining.
Space exploration is cheapest when it is shared.

items.meaning: tia bức xạ từ không gian
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; shield sb from + cosmic radiation
examples: Cosmic radiation limits how long a crew can stay out.
Shielding against cosmic radiation adds weight nobody can launch.

items.definition: measure + N; measure sth in + N
examples: They measured the drift in millimetres a year.
What cannot be measured still exists.

items.definition: calculate + N; danh từ calculation
examples: She calculated the orbit by hand in 1961.
They calculated the dose from body weight.

items.definition: analyse + N; thường bị động
examples: The samples were analysed in two laboratories.
They analysed nine years of readings in a fortnight.

items.definition: hypothesise that + clause
examples: They hypothesised that the gap was caused by the current.
He hypothesised a fourth source and then found it.

items.definition: prove + N; prove that + clause
examples: Nothing in the paper proves the mechanism.
They proved the opposite of what they set out to show.

items.definition: disprove + N; thường bị động
examples: The theory was disproved by one careful survey.
A single counterexample disproves the rule.

items.meaning: lặp lại nghiên cứu để kiểm chứng
items.definition: replicate + N; thường bị động
examples: The result has never been replicated.
Two groups replicated the finding independently.

items.meaning: mô phỏng, bắt chước cơ chế
items.definition: mimic + N; thường bị động
examples: The compound mimics the natural hormone.
They mimicked the flood conditions in a tank.

items.definition: discover + N; thường bị động
examples: The species was discovered in a market, not a forest.
They discovered the error after publication.

items.definition: isolate + N; thường bị động
examples: The compound was isolated from bark.
They isolated the effect by cooling the sample.

items.definition: synthesise + N; thường bị động
examples: The drug was synthesised in nine steps.
They synthesised the molecule and found a cheaper route.

items.definition: classify + N + as + N; thường bị động
examples: The specimen was classified as a new subspecies.
They classified every sample by depth.

items.definition: quantify + N; thường bị động
examples: The loss has never been quantified.
They quantified the effect for the first time.

items.definition: estimate + N + at + N; thường bị động
examples: The age was estimated at nine thousand years.
They estimated the population from nest counts.

items.definition: predict + N; predict that + clause
examples: The model predicted the surge within an hour.
Nobody predicted the second peak.

items.definition: scientific + N (evidence, consensus)
examples: Scientific consensus formed slowly and held.
The claim has no scientific basis at all.

items.meaning: dựa trên quan sát thực tế
items.definition: empirical + N (evidence, study)
examples: Empirical evidence contradicted the model twice.
The rule was empirical before anyone explained it.

items.definition: theoretical + N (physics, model)
examples: The objection is theoretical and still worth answering.
Theoretical work predicted the result by nine years.

items.definition: experimental + N (design, treatment)
examples: The experimental design had one obvious flaw.
Experimental results came in two years later.

items.definition: quantitative + N (data, method)
examples: Quantitative data settled the argument.
Quantitative methods reached the discipline late.

items.definition: qualitative + N (research, difference)
examples: Qualitative interviews explained what the numbers hid.
The difference is qualitative, not one of degree.

items.meaning: đòi hỏi độ chính xác cao
items.definition: exacting + N (standard, procedure)
examples: The procedure is exacting and desperately slow.
Exacting standards take the time nobody has.

items.definition: be reproducible; a reproducible + N
examples: The effect is reproducible in two laboratories.
Reproducible results are the only kind that count.

items.definition: be inconclusive; an inconclusive + N
examples: The trial was inconclusive and was never repeated.
Nine studies produced inconclusive results.

items.definition: groundbreaking + N (work, study)
examples: The groundbreaking paper was rejected twice first.
Groundbreaking work often looks dull at the time.

items.definition: a peer-reviewed + N (journal, paper)
examples: Only peer-reviewed work was accepted as evidence.
The claim has never appeared in a peer-reviewed journal.

items.definition: a hypothetical + N (case, scenario)
examples: The hypothetical case turned out to be real.
They modelled a hypothetical release of the gas.

items.definition: applied + N (research, science)
examples: Applied research attracts money; basic research attracts prizes.
The institute does applied work for the water industry.

items.definition: conduct + N; thường bị động
examples: They conducted the survey over two winters.
The tests were conducted in three laboratories.

items.definition: hit upon + N; không tách được
examples: She hit upon a simpler explanation.
They hit upon the design by accident.

items.meaning: dựa trên để phát triển thêm
items.definition: build on + N; không tách được
examples: The work builds on measurements made in 1958.
They built on a method nobody had published.

items.definition: narrow down + N hoặc narrow + N + down; tách được
examples: They narrowed the search down to nine sites.
The cause was narrowed down over two seasons.

items.definition: single out + N hoặc single + N + out; tách được
examples: One gene was singled out for closer study.
They singled the outlier out and reran everything.

items.definition: point to + N; không tách được
examples: The data point to a single source.
Everything points to contamination in the laboratory.

items.meaning: giải thích được, chiếm tỉ lệ
items.definition: account for + N; không tách được
examples: Measurement error accounts for most of the spread.
Two factors account for ninety per cent of the variation.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; reject/fail to reject + the null hypothesis
examples: The null hypothesis could not be rejected.
Stating the null hypothesis first disciplines the whole design.

items.meaning: kĩ thuật viên phòng thí nghiệm
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + laboratory technician + prepares
examples: The laboratory technician prepared nine hundred slides.
Two laboratory technicians keep the whole building running.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; win/renew + a research grant
examples: The research grant runs for three years.
They won a research grant at the fourth attempt.

items.definition: by/through + trial and error
examples: The method was found by trial and error over nine years.
Trial and error is a method, not a failure of method.

items.definition: go + back to the drawing board
examples: The result sent them back to the drawing board.
After the third failure it was back to the drawing board.

items.definition: have + a eureka moment
examples: The eureka moment came while washing up.
Real science has few eureka moments and many Tuesdays.

items.meaning: trụ được trước sự kiểm tra
items.definition: stand up to scrutiny
examples: The figures did not stand up to scrutiny.
Her method stood up to scrutiny from three reviewers.

items.definition: look for + a needle in a haystack
examples: Finding the source was a needle in a haystack.
Without the catalogue it is a needle in a haystack.

items.definition: in a nutshell
examples: In a nutshell, the sample was too small.
The argument in a nutshell is about timing.

items.definition: bear fruit
examples: The collaboration bore fruit after nine years.
Patient funding bears fruit long after the minister has gone.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; frame/narrow + a research question
examples: The research question was narrowed three times.
A good research question can be answered with the money available.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; submit/reject + a research proposal
examples: The research proposal was rejected twice before funding.
Writing the research proposal took longer than the pilot.

items.meaning: hội đồng đạo đức nghiên cứu
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; apply to/an + ethics committee
examples: The ethics committee asked for nine changes.
No work with patients begins without an ethics committee.

items.meaning: sự chấp thuận về đạo đức nghiên cứu
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; obtain/await + ethical approval
examples: Ethical approval took four months.
No fieldwork begins without ethical approval.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + funding body + awards
examples: The funding body favoured applied work that year.
Two funding bodies rejected the same application.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; the + principal investigator + leads
examples: The principal investigator never visited the field site.
A principal investigator holds the grant and the blame.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; employ/a + research assistant
examples: The research assistant did most of the counting.
Two research assistants were paid from one grant.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; present/a + conference paper
examples: The conference paper was never written up in full.
She presented the conference paper to nine people.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; attend/host + an academic conference
examples: The academic conference met every second year.
Nine countries sent delegates to the academic conference.

items.meaning: bản thảo công bố trước bình duyệt
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; post/cite + a preprint
examples: The preprint was cited before it was reviewed.
They posted a preprint and the story ran that evening.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; publish + in open access
examples: Open access shifted the cost from readers to authors.
The journal went open access in 2014.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; release/request + raw data
examples: The raw data was never released.
Raw data from the survey filled nine notebooks.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; begin/standardise + data collection
examples: Data collection ran for three summers.
Data collection methods changed halfway through.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; conduct/a + field survey
examples: The field survey covered ninety kilometres of coast.
A field survey in winter found nothing at all.

items.meaning: nghiên cứu theo thời gian dài
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + longitudinal study + follows
examples: The longitudinal study has followed the same children since 1970.
A longitudinal study costs little each year and everything in patience.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; conduct/a + meta-analysis
examples: The meta-analysis pooled nine small trials.
A meta-analysis inherits every weakness of its inputs.

items.meaning: thử nghiệm phân nhóm ngẫu nhiên
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; run/a + randomised trial
examples: The randomised trial settled a thirty-year argument.
A randomised trial was impossible for ethical reasons.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + double-blind trial + shows
examples: The double-blind trial showed no effect at all.
In a double-blind trial neither side knows who received what.

items.meaning: nghiên cứu thử nghiệm ban đầu
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; run/a + pilot study
examples: The pilot study used nine volunteers.
A pilot study saved them from a useless design.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + sampling method + biases
examples: The sampling method excluded anyone without a telephone.
They changed the sampling method and the result reversed.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; calculate/a large + standard deviation
examples: The standard deviation was larger than the mean.
They reported the mean and omitted the standard deviation.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a wide/report + a confidence interval
examples: The confidence interval includes zero.
A wide confidence interval is honest and unhelpful.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; exclude/an + outlier
examples: One outlier was excluded without explanation.
The outlier turned out to be the real finding.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; investigate/an + anomaly
examples: The anomaly appeared in every run.
They investigated the anomaly for two years.

items.meaning: kết quả không có hiệu ứng
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; publish/a + null result
examples: Null results are rarely published and always useful.
The experiment produced a null result three times.

items.meaning: khủng hoảng khả năng lặp lại
items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; the + reproducibility crisis
examples: The reproducibility crisis began with one large replication project.
The reproducibility crisis is a crisis of incentives.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; reach/dispute + scientific consensus
examples: Scientific consensus formed twenty years before the policy.
Disputing scientific consensus is cheap and effective.

items.meaning: trình độ hiểu biết khoa học
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; improve + scientific literacy
examples: Scientific literacy means knowing what a sample is.
Scientific literacy improves fastest through argument, not lectures.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; science communication + training
examples: Science communication is treated as an afterthought.
Good science communication admits the uncertainty.

items.meaning: việc gắn kết với công chúng
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; public engagement + activities
examples: Public engagement filled the laboratory with schoolchildren.
Public engagement is now written into every grant.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; research ethics + training/breach
examples: Research ethics training is a morning and a form.
The case changed research ethics in the whole field.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; investigate + academic misconduct
examples: The inquiry found academic misconduct in two papers.
Academic misconduct is usually found by a reader, not an auditor.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; uncover + data fabrication
examples: Data fabrication was uncovered by a graph that was too neat.
Data fabrication ended a thirty-year career.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + retracted paper + is still cited
examples: The retracted paper is still cited every year.
Nine retracted papers came from the same laboratory.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; keep/a + laboratory notebook
examples: The laboratory notebook settled who did the work.
She kept a laboratory notebook in pencil for forty years.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; build/an + instrument + records
examples: The instrument records a reading every six seconds.
They built the instrument from parts of two others.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + detector + registers
examples: The detector registered nine events in a year.
A colder detector sees fainter signals.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; run/a + computer model
examples: The computer model was run nine thousand times.
A computer model is only as honest as its assumptions.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; build/test + a scale model
examples: The scale model was tested in a water tank.
They built a scale model of the whole estuary.

items.meaning: công ti tách ra từ nghiên cứu
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; found/a + spin-out company
examples: The spin-out company employs eleven former students.
Two spin-out companies came from one laboratory.

items.definition: validate + N; thường bị động
examples: The model was validated against nine years of records.
They validated the method before using it in the field.

items.definition: calibrate + N; thường bị động
examples: The sensors are calibrated every fortnight.
They calibrated the instrument against a known standard.

items.definition: dissect + N; thường bị động
examples: The specimen was dissected under water.
They dissected the argument line by line.

items.meaning: suy rộng ra ngoài phạm vi dữ liệu
items.definition: extrapolate + N + from + N
examples: They extrapolated the trend from nine data points.
Extrapolating that far ahead is guesswork with arithmetic.

items.definition: deduce + N + from + N
examples: They deduced the structure from the diffraction pattern.
Nothing could be deduced from a single reading.

items.definition: infer + N + from + N
examples: Age was inferred from the growth rings.
They inferred the cause and could not prove it.

items.definition: postulate + N; postulate that + clause
examples: He postulated a second mechanism in 1937.
They postulated an unseen companion star.

items.definition: refute + N; thường bị động
examples: The claim was refuted by the original author.
They refuted the model with one field measurement.

items.definition: probe + N; danh từ a probe
examples: They probed the sediment to nine metres.
The committee probed the funding arrangements.

items.definition: trace + N + to/back to + N
examples: The contamination was traced to one tank.
They traced the lineage back nine generations.

items.definition: interdisciplinary + N (research, team)
examples: The interdisciplinary team shared nothing but a corridor at first.
Interdisciplinary research is praised and rarely funded.

items.definition: speculative + N (claim, model)
examples: The final section is openly speculative.
A speculative model is useful if it is labelled as one.

items.definition: provisional + N (finding, figure)
examples: The figures are provisional until the audit.
A provisional finding was reported as settled fact.

items.definition: a robust + N (result, method)
examples: The result is robust to every reasonable assumption.
A robust method survives careless hands.

items.definition: a flawed + N (study, design)
examples: The study was flawed and widely quoted.
A flawed design cannot be rescued by statistics.

items.definition: a systematic + N (review, error)
examples: A systematic review found nine usable trials.
Systematic error affects every reading the same way.

items.meaning: có đối chứng, có kiểm soát
items.definition: a controlled + N (trial, condition)
examples: Controlled conditions are impossible in a field.
The controlled trial took four years to arrange.

items.definition: an unproven + N (claim, treatment)
examples: The treatment remains unproven and widely sold.
An unproven claim was printed as a headline.

items.definition: a measurable + N (effect, change)
examples: The effect is real and barely measurable.
There was no measurable change in nine years.

items.meaning: nhỏ đến mức bỏ qua được
items.definition: be negligible; a negligible + N
examples: The difference is negligible at this scale.
The dose was negligible compared with background levels.

items.definition: a finite + N (resource, sample)
examples: The sample is finite and the questions are not.
Finite funding decided which site was studied.

items.definition: a plausible + N (explanation, mechanism)
examples: The explanation is plausible and unverified.
Two plausible mechanisms remain in contention.

items.meaning: đặt ra mục tiêu làm gì
items.definition: set out + to + V
examples: They set out to disprove their own model.
She set out to count every nest on the island.

items.definition: zero in on + N; không tách được
examples: They zeroed in on one stretch of the river.
The team zeroed in on a single enzyme.

items.definition: pin down + N hoặc pin + N + down; tách được
examples: The date could not be pinned down closer than a century.
They pinned the source down to one outflow.

items.definition: puzzle out + N hoặc puzzle + N + out; tách được
examples: They puzzled out the volume from three measurements.
She puzzled the sequence out over one winter.

items.meaning: rà soát kĩ khối lượng lớn
items.definition: sift through + N; không tách được
examples: They sifted through nine thousand records.
She sifted through the archive for two winters.

items.definition: map out + N hoặc map + N + out; tách được
examples: They mapped out the whole fault line.
The sequence was mapped out over four years.

items.definition: bear out + N hoặc bear + N + out; tách được
examples: The field data bore out the prediction.
Nothing in the survey bears that claim out.

items.definition: the jury is still out + on + N
examples: The jury is still out on the long-term effect.
On that mechanism the jury is still out.

items.definition: be + a shot in the dark
examples: The first attempt was a shot in the dark.
It was a shot in the dark that happened to work.

items.definition: be + the acid test + of + N
examples: Replication is the acid test of any finding.
The acid test comes when somebody else runs it.

items.definition: go hand in hand + with + N
examples: Measurement and theory go hand in hand here.
Careful notes and good results go hand in hand.

items.definition: be + open to question
examples: The interpretation is open to question.
Their sampling remains open to question.

items.definition: be/make + a quantum leap
examples: The new detector was a quantum leap in sensitivity.
Sequencing made a quantum leap in a single decade.

topics.title: Family & Children
topics.description: Từ vựng về chăm sóc trẻ em, quan hệ gia đình và hỗ trợ giữa các thế hệ.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + nuclear family + of + số người
examples: The nuclear family was a postwar arrangement, not an ancient one.
Housing here is built for a nuclear family of four.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; live with/an + extended family
examples: Three generations of the extended family share the yard.
An extended family absorbs a crisis better than a couple can.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + single-parent family + raises
examples: A quarter of pupils come from single-parent families.
Single-parent families lost the most in the benefit freeze.

items.meaning: gia đình kết hợp hai bên
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + blended family + forms
examples: The blended family took three years to settle.
In a blended family the rules have to be renegotiated.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; place sb with + a foster family
examples: He was placed with a foster family at nine.
Foster families are paid an allowance, not a wage.

items.definition: danh từ số nhiều; her/his + adoptive parents
examples: Her adoptive parents told her at seven.
Adoptive parents wait an average of two years.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a legal + guardian
examples: His aunt became his legal guardian.
A guardian must sign every school form.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; an older/a younger + sibling
examples: She has four siblings and sees two of them.
Older siblings do a third of the childcare here.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; be/grow up as + an only child
examples: He grew up as an only child in a crowded street.
Being an only child was unusual in that generation.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; identical/be + twins
examples: The twins were separated at school deliberately.
Identical twins are studied for exactly this reason.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; his/her + stepmother
examples: His stepmother raised him from the age of six.
The word stepmother carries a thousand bad stories.

items.meaning: con riêng của vợ hoặc chồng
items.definition: danh từ đếm được, số nhiều stepchildren; a + stepchild
examples: Her stepchild moved in at fourteen.
Two stepchildren inherited nothing under the old law.

items.meaning: họ hàng bên vợ hoặc chồng
items.definition: danh từ số nhiều; his/her + in-laws
examples: They lived with his in-laws for two years.
Her in-laws are nine kilometres away and visit daily.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; his/her + mother-in-law
examples: Her mother-in-law moved in after the stroke.
His mother-in-law ran the family finances.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + grandparent + looks after
examples: Grandparents provide most of the childcare in this district.
Both grandparents live in the next street.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; trace/an + ancestor
examples: Her ancestors came over as weavers.
He traced an ancestor to a single farm.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a direct + descendant
examples: A direct descendant still farms the land.
Nine descendants attended the reunion.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a distant/a close + relative
examples: A distant relative left her the cottage.
Close relatives were told before anyone else.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; kinship + ties/networks
examples: Kinship networks found the first jobs for every arrival.
Kinship decided who inherited the boat.

items.meaning: các mối ràng buộc gia đình
items.definition: danh từ số nhiều; strong/loosen + family ties
examples: Family ties pulled him back after nine years abroad.
Distance loosened the family ties slowly.

items.meaning: sự giáo dục trong gia đình
items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; a strict/a happy + upbringing
examples: He had a strict upbringing and a gentle manner.
Her upbringing explains her carefulness with money.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; shared/a + parenting + class
examples: Shared parenting was unusual in that street.
Parenting classes helped more than the leaflets did.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; an authoritarian + parenting style
examples: Their parenting style was firm and predictable.
Two parenting styles in one house confuse a child.

items.meaning: giới hạn rõ ràng trong nuôi dạy
items.definition: danh từ số nhiều; set/keep + firm boundaries
examples: Firm boundaries at home were consistent and gently kept.
Firm boundaries without warmth produce secrecy.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; affordable/arrange + childcare
examples: Affordable childcare decides whether mothers return to work.
Childcare costs more than her rent.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a registered + childminder
examples: A registered childminder takes three children a day.
The childminder lives two doors away.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; find/pay + a babysitter
examples: Finding a babysitter on a Saturday is impossible here.
The babysitter is their oldest niece.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; take/return from + maternity leave
examples: She took nine months of maternity leave.
Maternity leave is paid at a fraction of the salary.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; take/two weeks of + paternity leave
examples: Paternity leave is two weeks and rarely all taken.
He took paternity leave and was asked about it for years.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; claim/freeze + child benefit
examples: Child benefit was frozen for six years.
She claims child benefit for three children.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; a long/an arranged + marriage
examples: The marriage lasted fifty-one years.
Marriage rates have fallen in every age group.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; hold/a small + wedding
examples: The wedding was held in the village hall.
A small wedding suited them both.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; announce/break off + an engagement
examples: The engagement was announced at Christmas.
They broke off the engagement and stayed friends.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; go on + a honeymoon
examples: They went on honeymoon to the next county.
The honeymoon lasted four days and forty years.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + spouse + inherits
examples: A surviving spouse inherits the tenancy.
Each spouse kept their own name.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a long-term + partner
examples: Her long-term partner has no legal status here.
They have been partners for nineteen years.

items.meaning: việc sống chung không kết hôn
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; cohabitation + rates
examples: Cohabitation overtook marriage in that age group.
Cohabitation carries fewer rights than people assume.

items.meaning: quan hệ dân sự có đăng kí
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; enter into + a civil partnership
examples: They entered into a civil partnership in 2006.
A civil partnership was the only option available then.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; file for/go through + a divorce
examples: The divorce took two years and most of the savings.
Divorce rates peaked in the 1990s.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a trial/a legal + separation
examples: The separation was amicable for about a month.
A legal separation precedes most divorces here.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; be granted/share + child custody
examples: Child custody was shared equally.
The child custody hearing lasted three days.

items.meaning: tiền trợ cấp sau li hôn
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; pay/receive + alimony
examples: He paid alimony for eleven years.
Alimony was replaced by a single settlement.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + widow + inherits
examples: The widow kept the farm going alone.
Nine widows live on the same terrace.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + widower + lives
examples: The widower cooked for himself for the first time at seventy.
A widower is more isolated than a widow, the study found.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; build/end + a relationship
examples: The relationship survived two separations.
They built the relationship on long letters.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; a long + courtship
examples: Their courtship lasted seven years.
Courtship then involved chaperones and letters.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; online + dating
examples: Online dating is how most couples here now meet.
Dating at fifty is a different activity entirely.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; be in + a long-distance relationship
examples: They were in a long-distance relationship for four years.
A long-distance relationship survives on routine, not romance.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; make/avoid + a commitment
examples: The commitment was never in doubt.
He avoided commitment until he was forty.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; show/repay + loyalty
examples: Her loyalty to her brother cost her a job.
Loyalty in that family was never discussed and never broken.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; show/withhold + affection
examples: Affection in that house was shown in food, not words.
He showed affection awkwardly and constantly.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; emotional + intimacy
examples: Emotional intimacy took them a decade.
Intimacy is easier to lose than to explain.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; seek/offer + companionship
examples: She married again for companionship and said so.
The dog provides companionship nobody else can.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; have/settle + an argument
examples: The argument was about money and not about money.
They had the same argument for thirty years.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; a + reconciliation + follows
examples: The reconciliation came at a funeral.
Reconciliation took nine years and one letter.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; a long + estrangement
examples: The estrangement lasted until his illness.
Estrangement between siblings is commoner than anyone admits.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + family feud + splits
examples: The family feud began over a field.
A family feud emptied two pews in the chapel.

items.meaning: sự ganh đua giữa các con
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; sibling rivalry + persists
examples: Sibling rivalry outlasted both parents.
Sibling rivalry over the farm ended in court.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; meet/resist + parental expectation
examples: She resisted parental expectation and left the business.
Parental expectation decided which subject he studied.

items.meaning: tuổi dậy thì, tuổi vị thành niên
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; during/throughout + adolescence
examples: Adolescence lasted longer than either parent expected.
During adolescence the arguments were nightly.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + teenager + rebels/studies
examples: Two teenagers share the back bedroom.
Teenagers here leave for the city at eighteen.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; reach/enter + adulthood
examples: They reached adulthood in a recession.
Adulthood arrives later than it did in 1970.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; in/reach + middle age
examples: In middle age he went back to study.
Middle age brought the first real free time.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; in/provide for + old age
examples: Old age in that village means neighbours, not nurses.
Nobody had provided for old age.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; the + empty nest
examples: The empty nest was harder on him than on her.
They filled the empty nest with lodgers.

items.meaning: người chăm sóc trong gia đình
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; an unpaid + family carer
examples: Unpaid family carers do more than the whole service.
She has been a family carer since she was nineteen.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; at/a shared + mealtime
examples: Mealtimes are the only time all five sit down.
Shared mealtimes survived the shift work, just.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; hold/a small + get-together
examples: The get-together filled two rooms.
Every get-together ends with the same stories.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; hold/a + family reunion
examples: The family reunion brought nine relatives from abroad.
A family reunion every five years keeps the cousins in touch.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a family + heirloom
examples: The clock is the only heirloom left.
A family heirloom is worth nothing and everything.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; keep/take + a family name
examples: She kept her family name after marrying.
The family name died out in the male line.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; trace/draw up + a family tree
examples: The family tree goes back to 1780.
Drawing up the family tree revealed two secrets.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + godparent + promises
examples: Her godparent paid for the piano lessons.
Godparents were chosen for practical reasons.

items.definition: raise + N (a child, a family)
examples: She raised four children on one wage.
They were raised by their grandmother.

items.definition: nurture + N; thường bị động
examples: The talent was nurtured by one teacher and one uncle.
They nurtured the habit of reading at the kitchen table.

items.definition: spoil + sb; thường bị động
examples: The youngest was spoiled and knows it.
Grandparents spoil children; that is the arrangement.

items.definition: scold + sb + for + N
examples: She scolded them for the mud and fed them anyway.
He was scolded in two languages.

items.definition: praise + sb + for + N; thường bị động
examples: He was praised for the effort rather than the mark.
They praised her in public and corrected her at home.

items.definition: obey + sb; obey + N (a rule)
examples: Children obeyed without discussion in that house.
He obeyed the rule and resented it for years.

items.definition: rebel against + N
examples: She rebelled against the whole arrangement at seventeen.
He rebelled quietly by reading what he liked.

items.definition: confide in + sb
examples: She confided in her aunt rather than her mother.
He confided in nobody for thirty years.

items.definition: bond with + sb; danh từ a bond
examples: They bonded over the garden.
He bonded with the baby late and completely.

items.definition: propose to + sb
examples: He proposed on the harbour wall.
She proposed first and he said yes twice.

items.definition: marry + sb; get married to + sb
examples: They married in the same chapel as her parents.
She married at nineteen and studied at forty.

items.definition: separate; separate from + sb
examples: They separated for a year and came back together.
He separated from his wife in 2014.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; go through + the adoption process
