items.definition: an overlooked + N (group, town)
examples: Overlooked towns appear in the data and not in the plans.
The night staff were the overlooked half of the service.

items.definition: the + voiceless; a voiceless + N
examples: The scheme was designed for a voiceless group and without them.
Nobody is voiceless; some are simply not listened to.

items.definition: reach out to + sb; không tách được
examples: The centre reached out to households nobody had contacted.
They reached out to nine families and heard from two.

items.definition: look out for + sb; không tách được
examples: Neighbours look out for the older residents in cold weather.
They looked out for each other through the whole dispute.

items.definition: stick up for + sb; không tách được
examples: One supervisor stuck up for the whole night shift.
She sticks up for anyone treated badly at the counter.

items.definition: take on board + N hoặc take + N + on board
examples: The panel took the objections on board and changed nothing.
They took on board every comment from the residents.

items.meaning: bị bỏ sót khỏi hệ thống
items.definition: fall through the net
examples: Nine households fell through the net entirely.
Anyone without an address falls through the net.

items.definition: get by; get by on + N
examples: They get by on one wage and a lot of planning.
She got by for nine months without any help.

items.definition: make do; make do with + N
examples: They made do with one heated room.
Making do is a skill and not a virtue.

items.definition: scrape by; scrape by on + N
examples: They scraped by until the boiler failed.
Nine households on that landing scrape by every winter.

items.definition: chip in; chip in for + N
examples: Neighbours chipped in for the funeral.
Everyone chipped in and the minibus was bought.

items.definition: club together + to + V
examples: They clubbed together to pay the fare.
Nine families clubbed together for a single freezer.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; set/raise + a wage floor
examples: A statutory wage floor removed the worst of the undercutting.
Raising the wage floor lifted nine thousand households.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; impose/the + benefit cap
examples: The benefit cap takes no account of local rents.
A benefit cap hits the largest families hardest.

items.meaning: dịch vụ đi lại do cộng đồng tổ chức
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; run + community transport
examples: Community transport takes nine passengers to the clinic.
Community transport replaced the route the company dropped.

items.definition: danh từ số nhiều; campaign for + disability rights
examples: Disability rights were won by protest, not by committee.
Disability rights law changed buildings more slowly than attitudes.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; challenge/reinforce + a gender stereotype
examples: The advertisement reinforced every gender stereotype going.
Challenging gender stereotypes begins with the reading books.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; demand/receive + equal treatment
examples: Equal treatment at the counter is cheaper than any policy.
They demanded equal treatment and were offered a leaflet.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + charity shop + raises
examples: Nine charity shops trade on that high street.
The charity shop funds the whole advice service.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; run/a + soup kitchen
examples: The soup kitchen opens four nights a week.
A soup kitchen in a wealthy district says something.

items.meaning: điểm sưởi ấm cho người dân
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; open/a + warm bank
examples: Libraries opened as warm banks that winter.
A warm bank is a library with the heating left on.

items.definition: give/need + a helping hand
examples: A helping hand at the right week prevents a year of debt.
They gave her a helping hand and no advice.

items.definition: pull together
examples: The street pulled together after the flooding.
They pulled together for a fortnight and then argued.

items.definition: give back + to + N
examples: He gives back to the club that taught him.
Giving back here means turning up on Saturdays.

items.definition: go without + N
examples: Parents go without so the children do not.
They went without heating for most of February.

items.definition: live + from hand to mouth
examples: They lived from hand to mouth for nine months.
Living from hand to mouth makes planning impossible.

items.definition: be/live + on the breadline
examples: A fifth of the ward lives on the breadline.
They were on the breadline and both in work.

items.definition: make ends meet
examples: Two jobs were needed to make ends meet.
She makes ends meet by doing without.

items.definition: be/provide + a lifeline
examples: The bus is a lifeline for nine villages.
The weekly visit was a lifeline nobody funded.

items.definition: afford + the bare necessities
examples: They can afford the bare necessities and nothing unexpected.
The grant covers the bare necessities only.

items.definition: know one's rights
examples: Tenants who know their rights are treated differently.
She knew her rights and brought the letter with her.

topics.title: Language & Communication
topics.description: Từ vựng về giao tiếp, khả năng tiếp cận ngôn ngữ và kỹ năng đánh giá thông tin.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; rely on + verbal communication
examples: Verbal communication carries less of the meaning than people assume.
The job depends on verbal communication under pressure.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; non-verbal communication + conveys
examples: Non-verbal communication conveys most of the attitude.
Non-verbal communication differs sharply between the two regions.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; read/open + body language
examples: Her body language said the opposite of her answer.
Reading body language is a skill, not a party trick.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + facial expression + gives sth away
examples: One facial expression ended the negotiation.
Facial expressions are read faster than words.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; make/avoid + eye contact
examples: He avoided eye contact for the whole interview.
Eye contact means confidence in one culture and rudeness in another.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; make/a + gesture
examples: One gesture replaced a whole sentence.
Gestures travel badly across borders.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a sharp/change + tone of voice
examples: The tone of voice carried the whole message.
She changed her tone of voice and the room settled.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; rising/falling + intonation
examples: Rising intonation turns a statement into a question.
Intonation is the hardest thing to teach.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; correct/work on + pronunciation
examples: Her pronunciation is clearer than most native speakers'.
They work on pronunciation for ten minutes a lesson.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a strong/lose + an accent
examples: His accent moved two counties in forty years.
A strong accent was held against her at every interview.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; speak/record + a dialect
examples: The dialect survives in two valleys.
Nine dialect words were recorded from one speaker.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; speak/lose + a mother tongue
examples: She lost her mother tongue by the age of twelve.
Teaching in the mother tongue improved the results immediately.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + first language + speaker
examples: Nine first languages are spoken in that one class.
His first language is not the language of the paperwork.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; learn/a + second language
examples: English is a second language for most of the staff.
Learning a second language after fifty is slow and possible.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; study/a + foreign language
examples: Foreign language teaching was cut in nine schools.
She studied two foreign languages and uses one.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; bilingualism + is the norm
examples: Bilingualism is the norm in most of the world.
Bilingualism was discouraged in that generation of schools.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; multilingualism + in a city
examples: Multilingualism is the ordinary condition of that market.
Multilingualism costs a school nothing and gains it a great deal.

items.meaning: ngôn ngữ chung để giao tiếp
items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; serve as + a lingua franca
examples: English serves as a lingua franca in the whole industry.
A lingua franca belongs to nobody in the room.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; overcome/face + a language barrier
examples: The language barrier kept nine families from the service.
A language barrier is removed by one interpreter.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; simultaneous + interpreting
examples: Simultaneous interpreting exhausts the interpreter in twenty minutes.
Interpreting was provided for two of the nine languages.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; develop/assess + fluency
examples: Fluency came before accuracy for both of them.
They assess fluency by how little the listener works.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; demonstrate/a + proficiency + test
examples: The proficiency test decides the visa.
Proficiency in writing lagged behind speaking by a year.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; build/an active + vocabulary
examples: An active vocabulary of two thousand words carries most conversation.
She built her vocabulary from the radio.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; teach/a point of + grammar
examples: Grammar was taught as rules and remembered as reflexes.
One point of grammar changes the whole meaning.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; use/local + slang
examples: Local slang dates a speaker within five years.
Slang moves faster than any dictionary.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; use/avoid + jargon
examples: The leaflet is written in jargon nobody outside uses.
Jargon excludes as efficiently as a locked door.

items.meaning: mức độ trang trọng của ngôn ngữ
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a formal/shift + register
examples: The formal register of the letter frightened the reader.
She shifts register between the ward and the committee.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; make + small talk
examples: Small talk is the hardest part in a second language.
He makes no small talk and everybody trusts him.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; have/start + a conversation
examples: The conversation lasted nine minutes and changed the policy.
She starts a conversation with anyone at a bus stop.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; open/maintain + a dialogue
examples: A dialogue was opened between the two unions.
They maintained a dialogue through nine difficult months.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; hold/a frank + discussion
examples: The discussion was frank and went nowhere.
Nine discussions preceded one decision.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; fear/practise + public speaking
examples: Public speaking terrified her until she had something to say.
Public speaking is taught in two lessons and learned in nine years.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; give/draft + a speech
examples: The speech lasted four minutes and is still quoted.
He drafted the speech nine times.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; a + miscommunication + occurs
examples: A miscommunication between two departments cost a week.
Most of it was miscommunication rather than disagreement.

items.meaning: nhận xét mang tính xây dựng
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; give/receive + a constructive comment
examples: Constructive comments are rarer than praise.
They gave their constructive comments in writing and in private.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; accept/constructive + criticism
examples: Constructive criticism improved the second draft.
She takes criticism better than compliments.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; pay/receive + a compliment
examples: He paid her a compliment she remembered for years.
A compliment in public is worth nine in private.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; spread/local + gossip
examples: Local gossip knew before the official letter arrived.
Gossip in a small place is a form of record-keeping.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; write/receive + a handwritten letter
examples: A handwritten letter still arrives differently.
She wrote a handwritten letter to every family.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; make/return + a phone call
examples: One phone call settled what nine emails could not.
He returns every phone call the same day.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; make/a + video call
examples: A video call replaced the monthly journey.
Video calls keep the grandparents in the room.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; leave/check + voicemail
examples: He left a voicemail nobody listened to for a week.
Her voicemail is full for most of the term.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; send/a + text message
examples: A text message is the only way to reach the night staff.
Nine text messages said less than one call.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + group chat + organises
examples: The street group chat organised the whole clean-up.
A group chat of ninety people decides nothing.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; use/learn + sign language
examples: Sign language is a language, not a code for English.
Two staff learned sign language for one patient.

items.meaning: chữ nổi cho người khiếm thị
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; read/in + braille
examples: The menu is available in braille on request.
She reads braille faster than most people read print.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; rely on + lip-reading
examples: Masks removed lip-reading as an option overnight.
Lip-reading catches about a third of what is said.

items.definition: communicate + N + to + sb
examples: The decision was communicated by a notice on the door.
They communicate badly and work together perfectly.

items.definition: converse with + sb + about + N
examples: They conversed in two languages at once.
He conversed easily with anyone on any shift.

items.definition: chat; chat to/with + sb
examples: They chatted for an hour about nothing of consequence.
She chats to every customer and remembers all of it.

items.definition: mumble; mumble + N
examples: He mumbled the answer and had to repeat it.
Nobody heard the question; the speaker mumbled.

items.definition: mutter; mutter + N
examples: She muttered something about the paperwork.
He muttered a complaint and signed anyway.

items.definition: whisper; whisper + N + to + sb
examples: They whispered through the whole lecture.
She whispered the answer to the next desk.

items.definition: shout; shout at + sb
examples: Shouting across a workshop is normal and not rude.
He shouted at nobody in nine years.

items.definition: interrupt + sb; thường bị động
examples: She was interrupted nine times in twenty minutes.
They interrupt each other constantly and cheerfully.

items.definition: listen to + sb/N
examples: Nobody listened to the night staff until the inspection.
She listens more than she speaks and misses nothing.

items.definition: overhear + N; quá khứ overheard
examples: He overheard the decision in a corridor.
They overheard enough to be worried.

items.definition: eavesdrop on + sb
examples: She eavesdropped on the meeting from the next room.
Nobody needed to eavesdrop; the walls were thin.

items.definition: clarify + N; thường bị động
examples: One sentence clarified the whole instruction.
They clarified the rule after nine complaints.

items.definition: restate + N; thường bị động
examples: He restated the question for the whole room.
She restated the letter in words people could use.

items.definition: condense + N + into + N; thường bị động
examples: The report was condensed into nine lines.
She condensed an hour of argument accurately.

items.definition: elaborate on + N
examples: He refused to elaborate on the figure.
She elaborated at length and said very little.

items.definition: digress; digress from + N
examples: The speaker digressed for nine minutes.
He digresses and then lands exactly on the point.

items.definition: persuade + sb + to + V
examples: They persuaded the council to keep one route.
She was persuaded by the figures, not the speech.

items.definition: convince + sb + of + N
examples: The survey convinced nobody on the committee.
He convinced them in four sentences.

items.definition: translate + N + into + N; thường bị động
examples: The leaflet was translated into nine languages badly.
She translates from two languages into one.

items.definition: stammer; danh từ a stammer
examples: He stammered as a child and lectures now.
She stammered only on the telephone.

items.definition: voice + N (a concern, an objection)
examples: He voiced what the whole ward had been thinking.
The grievance was voiced clearly and ignored.

items.definition: a well-spoken + N (speaker, applicant)
examples: A well-spoken applicant was assumed to be competent.
She is well-spoken in her second language and shy in her first.

items.definition: be inarticulate; an inarticulate + N
examples: He was inarticulate with rage and perfectly clear.
An inarticulate witness is not an unreliable one.

items.definition: be fluent + in + N
examples: She is fluent in three languages and modest about all of them.
He became fluent in a year of night classes.

items.definition: an eloquent + N (speech, defence)
examples: The most eloquent speech of the night came from a tenant.
An eloquent case was made and lost by one vote.

items.definition: be concise; a concise + N
examples: The report is concise and leaves nothing out.
Concise writing takes four drafts.

items.definition: be verbose; a verbose + N
examples: The guidance is verbose and still unclear.
A verbose answer usually hides a thin one.

items.definition: be blunt; a blunt + N
examples: He is blunt and never unkind.
A blunt refusal saved everyone three weeks.

items.definition: be tactful; a tactful + N
examples: She was tactful about the error and clear about the fix.
A tactful reminder works better than a formal one.

items.definition: be tactless; a tactless + N
examples: The letter was tactless rather than hostile.
A tactless remark at the wrong hour started the dispute.

items.definition: be diplomatic; a diplomatic + N
examples: The answer was diplomatic and told them nothing.
She is diplomatic with everyone except the suppliers.

items.definition: be assertive; an assertive + N
examples: Being assertive was taught on a one-day course.
An assertive request is not an aggressive one.

items.definition: a persuasive + N (argument, case)
examples: The persuasive part was the table of figures.
A persuasive case needs one fact and one example.

items.definition: be ambiguous; an ambiguous + N
examples: The wording is ambiguous and was meant to be.
An ambiguous instruction produces nine different actions.

items.definition: be explicit + about + N
examples: The letter was explicit about the deadline.
They were explicit about the risk and vague about the cost.

items.definition: be implicit + in + N
examples: The threat was implicit in the timing.
An implicit rule is harder to challenge than a written one.

items.definition: be long-winded; a long-winded + N
examples: The explanation was long-winded and accurate.
A long-winded preamble lost half the room.

items.definition: be talkative; a talkative + N
examples: He is talkative with strangers and silent at home.
A talkative neighbour is an information service.

items.definition: be outspoken + about + N
examples: She was outspoken about the closures and lost the contract.
An outspoken member keeps a committee honest.

items.definition: speak up; không có tân ngữ
examples: Speak up; the room is noisy.
Nobody spoke up until the third meeting.

items.definition: talk over + sb hoặc talk + sb + over; tách được
examples: He talked over her twice and apologised once.
They talk over each other and still agree.

items.definition: cut in; cut in on + sb
examples: She cut in with one question that ended it.
He cut in on every answer.

items.definition: butt in; butt in on + N
examples: A stranger butted in with the right advice.
He butted in before the sentence was finished.

items.definition: get + N + across; tách được
examples: The point got across in the end.
She got the whole argument across in two minutes.

items.meaning: trình bày cho người khác hiểu
items.definition: put + N + across; tách được
examples: He put the case across without raising his voice.
They put across a complicated idea with one diagram.

items.definition: touch on + N; không tách được
examples: The report touches on the cost and moves away.
She touched on the dispute and said nothing new.

items.definition: dwell on + N; không tách được
examples: He dwelt on the error for nine minutes.
They dwell on the past and plan nothing.

items.definition: wrap up + N hoặc wrap + N + up; tách được
examples: She wrapped up the meeting in two sentences.
They wrapped the discussion up before the hour.

items.definition: flag up + N hoặc flag + N + up; tách được
examples: One member flagged up the missing figure.
She flagged the contradiction up politely.

items.definition: talk + sb + round; tách được
examples: They talked him round over two evenings.
She was talked round by the figures.

items.definition: hear + sb + out; tách được
examples: The panel heard her out and ruled against her.
Hear him out before deciding.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; book/an + interpreter
examples: An interpreter was booked for the hearing and never arrived.
The interpreter translated the question and the hesitation.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + translator + works
examples: The translator worked from two languages into one.
A good translator is invisible in the result.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; pin sth on + a noticeboard
examples: The decision appeared on the noticeboard and nowhere else.
Nine notices cover the board and nobody reads them.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; make/a + public announcement
examples: The public announcement came after the staff had guessed.
A public announcement was made over the station speakers.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; test for + language aptitude
examples: Language aptitude matters less than daily practice.
They tested for language aptitude and ignored the result.

items.meaning: hoạt động làm quen mở đầu
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; use/an + icebreaker
examples: The icebreaker was awkward and worked anyway.
One icebreaker turned nine strangers into a working group.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; provide + a plain-language summary
examples: Every report now carries a plain-language summary.
The plain-language summary was read nine times more often.

items.definition: get to the point
examples: He takes nine minutes to get to the point.
Get to the point; the room has another meeting.

items.definition: beat about the bush
examples: They beat about the bush for half an hour.
Stop beating about the bush and name the figure.

items.definition: speak one's mind
examples: She speaks her mind and is trusted for it.
He spoke his mind once and was not invited back.

items.definition: be + a slip of the tongue
examples: It was a slip of the tongue and ran for a week in the papers.
A slip of the tongue revealed the real figure.

items.definition: be + on the same wavelength
examples: They were on the same wavelength from the first meeting.
The two departments are never on the same wavelength.

items.definition: be/talk + at cross purposes
examples: They had been talking at cross purposes for an hour.
The two sides were at cross purposes about the dates.

items.definition: be + lost in translation
examples: The joke was lost in translation entirely.
Something was lost in translation between the two reports.

items.meaning: phá tan bầu không khí e dè
items.definition: break the ice
examples: One question about the weather broke the ice.
She broke the ice by admitting she was lost.

items.definition: in a word
examples: In a word, the scheme failed.
In a word, yes, and the detail took an hour.

items.definition: have the last word
examples: He always has the last word and rarely the best one.
The committee had the last word and the tenants had the problem.

items.definition: be + a figure of speech
examples: It was a figure of speech and taken literally.
A figure of speech translated word for word becomes nonsense.

items.definition: by/through + word of mouth
examples: The class filled by word of mouth alone.
Word of mouth reaches the people a leaflet never does.

items.definition: to put it bluntly
examples: To put it bluntly, the money has gone.
To put it bluntly, nobody read the report.

items.definition: take the hint
examples: He took the hint and withdrew the application.
Nobody took the hint until it was put in writing.

items.definition: talk shop
examples: They talk shop for the whole hour.
No talking shop at the table, she said.

items.definition: be + a two-way conversation
examples: Consultation should be a two-way conversation.
It was never a two-way conversation; the decision was made.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; language learning + at school
examples: Language learning collapsed when it stopped being compulsory.
Language learning after forty is slower and more deliberate.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; do/a + language exchange
examples: They do a language exchange over coffee every Thursday.
A language exchange costs nothing and works.

items.meaning: chương trình học ngâm mình trong ngôn ngữ
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; an + immersion programme + runs
examples: The immersion programme teaches every subject in the second language.
Nine schools run an immersion programme in that county.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; do + listening practice
examples: Listening practice from the radio beat any textbook.
She does listening practice on the bus.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; do/a + role play
examples: The role play prepared them for the awkward questions.
Role play feels absurd and works.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; make/use + flashcards
examples: Nine hundred flashcards sit in a shoebox.
She made flashcards from the day's conversation.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; consult/a bilingual + dictionary
examples: A bilingual dictionary answers the question and hides the idiom.
He reads the dictionary for pleasure.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; use/a + thesaurus
examples: A thesaurus used badly makes writing worse.
She keeps a thesaurus beside the typewriter still.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; learn/a set + phrase
examples: A set phrase is remembered whole, not built.
Nine phrases will get you through a market.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a relative/a subordinate + clause
examples: A relative clause can carry the whole qualification.
The sentence has four clauses and no verb that matters.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; word order + differs
examples: Word order differs sharply between the two languages.
Word order carries the emphasis in English.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; check/irregular + spelling
examples: English spelling records a pronunciation nobody uses now.
Her spelling is faultless in her second language.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; punctuation + changes the meaning
examples: One comma of punctuation changed the whole clause.
Punctuation is breathing written down.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; legible/read + handwriting
examples: His handwriting defeated two secretaries.
Legible handwriting is a courtesy and a rarity.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; minute-taking + at meetings
examples: Careful minute-taking saved the whole case.
Minute-taking by hand is slower and remembered better.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; write/learn + shorthand
examples: She learned shorthand in 1968 and still uses it.
Shorthand recorded the hearing word for word.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + verbatim record + of + N
examples: The verbatim record runs to nine hundred pages.
A verbatim record settles what was actually said.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; live + captioning
examples: Live captioning made the lecture usable for nine students.
Automatic captioning mangles every proper name.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + pronunciation guide + helps
examples: The pronunciation guide uses the phonetic alphabet.
A pronunciation guide in brackets is worth nine repetitions.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; learn/the + phonetic alphabet
examples: The phonetic alphabet is learned in a week and used for life.
She annotates every new word with the phonetic alphabet.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; a national + language policy
examples: The language policy made two languages official.
Language policy decides which children feel at home.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; an + official language + of + N
examples: The country has two official languages and nine spoken ones.
Making it an official language changed every form.

items.meaning: ngôn ngữ của nhóm thiểu số
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; protect/teach + a minority language
examples: The minority language is taught in nine schools.
A minority language survives in the kitchen longest.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; a + language revival + movement
examples: The language revival began with one nursery.
Language revival takes a generation and a television channel.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; language loss + accelerates
examples: Language loss accelerated after the school closed.
Language loss is complete when the jokes stop working.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + loanword + enters
examples: Nine loanwords entered the trade from one language.
A loanword keeps its spelling and loses its sound.

items.meaning: từ dễ gây hiểu sai giữa hai ngôn ngữ
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + false friend + misleads
examples: That word is a false friend and causes real confusion.
False friends catch out the advanced learner, not the beginner.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; use/a mixed + metaphor
examples: The metaphor did more work than the argument.
A mixed metaphor makes the reader stop.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; quote/a local + proverb
examples: The proverb exists in both languages with different animals.
She quotes a proverb instead of giving advice.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + catchphrase + sticks
examples: The catchphrase outlived the programme by thirty years.
A catchphrase saves the speaker from thinking.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; use/an + acronym
examples: The report uses nine acronyms and explains two.
An acronym excludes the reader who needs the report.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; an + abbreviation + stands for + N
examples: The abbreviation stands for something nobody remembers.
Abbreviations save space and lose readers.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; use/a + euphemism + for + N
examples: Restructuring is a euphemism for redundancy.
Nine euphemisms hid one simple decision.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a masterly + understatement
examples: Calling it inconvenient was an understatement.
Understatement is the local form of emphasis.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; a gross + exaggeration
examples: The figure was a gross exaggeration and was repeated anyway.
Exaggeration costs a speaker their next audience.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; tell/an + anecdote
examples: One anecdote carried more weight than the whole table.
She tells the same anecdote and improves it each year.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; turn-taking + in conversation
examples: Turn-taking differs between the two cultures by about a second.
Turn-taking collapses on a bad telephone line.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; practise + active listening
examples: Active listening means checking what you heard.
Active listening is taught in a morning and practised for years.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; ask + an open question
examples: One open question produced nine minutes of useful answer.
Open questions take longer and find more.

items.meaning: câu hỏi gợi ý sẵn đáp án
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; ask/avoid + a leading question
examples: The survey was built on leading questions.
A leading question tells you what the asker wants.

items.definition: enunciate + N; enunciate clearly
examples: She enunciates every syllable on the telephone.
He enunciated the address twice.

items.definition: address + N (a meeting, an audience)
examples: She addressed the meeting for four minutes.
He addressed the room in two languages.

items.definition: rephrase + N; thường bị động
examples: The question was rephrased and answered at once.
She rephrased the warning into something people acted on.

items.definition: stress + N; thường bị động
examples: The second syllable is stressed in that word.
He stressed the deadline three times.

items.definition: spell + N; spell sth out
examples: She spelled the name twice and it was still wrong.
Nobody spells that surname correctly first time.

items.definition: pronounce + N; thường bị động
examples: The place name is pronounced nothing like it is written.
He pronounces it the local way and is corrected by visitors.

items.definition: mispronounce + N; thường bị động
examples: Her name was mispronounced for nine years.
They mispronounced the word identically and cheerfully.

items.definition: nod; nod at + sb
examples: He nodded and said nothing for an hour.
She nodded at the question and answered a different one.

items.definition: greet + sb; thường bị động
examples: They greet every customer by name.
She was greeted in her own language for the first time in years.

items.definition: chatter; chatter about + N
examples: The children chattered all the way home.
They chattered about nothing and settled the whole rota.

items.definition: a bilingual + N (child, school, sign)
examples: Bilingual signs were put up in 1993.
A bilingual child translates for the whole family.

items.definition: a monolingual + N (country, speaker)
examples: A monolingual speaker underestimates how much work translation is.
The service was monolingual in a bilingual district.

items.definition: idiomatic + N (English, expression)
examples: Her English is idiomatic and slightly dated.
An idiomatic expression rarely survives word-for-word translation.

items.definition: colloquial + N (speech, usage)
examples: The colloquial form is shorter and warmer.
Colloquial usage changes faster than any grammar book.

items.definition: formal + N (letter, register)
examples: A formal letter frightens more people than it informs.
The formal register was wrong for the audience.

items.definition: informal + N (chat, note)
examples: An informal chat achieved what nine letters had not.
The informal note was the one everybody read.

items.definition: be polite; a polite + N
examples: The refusal was polite and absolute.
She is polite to everyone and firm with anyone.

items.definition: be impolite; an impolite + N
examples: Interrupting is impolite in one culture and normal in another.
The reply was impolite rather than hostile.

items.definition: be incomprehensible + to + sb
examples: The form is incomprehensible to the people who must fill it in.
His explanation was incomprehensible and well meant.

items.definition: a soft-spoken + N (speaker, man)
examples: A soft-spoken chair kept the meeting in order.
She is soft-spoken and never ignored.

items.definition: go on about + N; không tách được
examples: He goes on about the parking at every meeting.
They went on about the detail and missed the decision.

items.definition: shut up; không có tân ngữ
examples: Nobody told the room to shut up; it simply went quiet.
He shut up the moment the figures appeared.

items.definition: pipe up; không có tân ngữ
examples: A student piped up with the right objection.
Somebody piped up from the back of the hall.

items.definition: blurt out + N hoặc blurt + N + out; tách được
examples: He blurted out the figure before the embargo lifted.
She blurted the news out and regretted it.

items.definition: trail off; không có tân ngữ
examples: His sentence trailed off into nothing.
The explanation trailed off when the question came.

items.definition: spell out + N hoặc spell + N + out; tách được
examples: The letter spells out exactly what happens next.
She spelled the consequences out in four lines.

items.definition: write down + N hoặc write + N + down; tách được
examples: Write down the reference before you ring.
He wrote every instruction down and still followed none.

items.definition: read out + N hoặc read + N + out; tách được
examples: The names were read out in the hall.
She read the letter out to the whole room.

items.definition: call back; call + sb + back; tách được
examples: Nobody called back for nine days.
He called her back within the hour.

items.definition: not mince one's words
examples: She does not mince her words at a hearing.
He minced no words about the state of the roof.

items.definition: hold one's tongue
examples: He held his tongue for nine years.
She held her tongue until the vote was taken.

items.definition: drop a hint + about + N
examples: He dropped a hint about the closure in March.
She dropped enough hints to fill a report.

items.term: the wrong end of the stick
items.definition: get + the wrong end of the stick
examples: The committee got the wrong end of the stick entirely.
He had the wrong end of the stick and acted on it.

items.definition: speak volumes + about + N
examples: The empty chairs spoke volumes.
Her silence spoke volumes about the decision.

items.definition: a war of words + between + N
examples: A war of words ran for nine weeks in the local paper.
The war of words ended when the money ran out.

items.definition: say one's piece
examples: She said her piece and left.
Everyone was allowed to say their piece first.

items.definition: have a word with + sb
examples: He had a word with the supervisor and the shift changed.
She had a quiet word with both of them.

items.definition: in plain English
examples: In plain English, the service is closing.
The guidance was rewritten in plain English.

items.definition: take + N + at face value
examples: They took the statement at face value and were disappointed.
She takes nothing at face value now.

topics.title: Population & Migration
topics.description: Từ vựng về dịch chuyển dân cư, cơ hội xã hội và dịch vụ dành cho các nhóm tuổi.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; rapid/slow + population growth
examples: Population growth here comes from arrivals, not births.
Rapid population growth outran the water supply.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; face + population decline
examples: The county has faced population decline since 1961.
Population decline closes the school before it closes the shop.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a falling + birth rate
examples: The birth rate fell below replacement in 1973.
A falling birth rate reshapes every budget eventually.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; the + death rate + falls
examples: The death rate fell fastest among infants.
A rising death rate in one ward prompted the inquiry.

items.meaning: tỉ suất sinh theo phụ nữ
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; the total + fertility rate
examples: The total fertility rate is one point four here.
The fertility rate fell everywhere that schooling for girls rose.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; below + the replacement rate
examples: Births have been below the replacement rate for fifty years.
The replacement rate is about two point one children.

items.meaning: tử vong ở trẻ dưới năm tuổi
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; under-five mortality + falls
examples: Under-five mortality fell by nine tenths in one century.
Under-five mortality is the measure that exposes everything else.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; the + average lifespan + rises
examples: The average lifespan stalled after 2011 for the first time.
The average lifespan differs by nine years across the city.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; an + ageing population + needs
examples: An ageing population needs housing on one floor.
The ageing population is a success story with a bill attached.

items.meaning: thay đổi cơ cấu dân số
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; demographic change + reshapes
examples: Demographic change arrives slowly and cannot be reversed quickly.
Demographic change emptied nine primary schools.

items.meaning: quá trình chuyển đổi dân số
items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; the + demographic transition
examples: The demographic transition took a century here and a generation elsewhere.
The demographic transition ends with few births and long lives.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; the + age structure + of a population
examples: The age structure of the village is nine decades old.
A distorted age structure follows every wave of emigration.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; draw/a + population pyramid
examples: The population pyramid has become a column.
A population pyramid shows the war in one indented row.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a rising + dependency ratio
examples: The dependency ratio rises as the boomers retire.
A rising dependency ratio means fewer workers per pensioner.

items.meaning: dân số trong tuổi lao động
items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; the + working-age population + shrinks
examples: The working-age population shrank for nine consecutive years.
Migration keeps the working-age population stable.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; the postwar + baby boom
examples: The postwar baby boom filled every school in a decade.
A baby boom becomes a pension problem sixty years later.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + generation + grows up
examples: One generation left and the next could not afford to return.
Three generations live within nine streets.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + birth cohort + is followed
examples: The birth cohort of 1947 changed every institution it entered.
Nine birth cohorts have been followed since 1958.

items.meaning: cuộc tổng điều tra dân số
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; conduct/the + census
examples: The census is taken every ten years.
The census missed whole households without addresses.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; the + rural population + ages
examples: The rural population is older and more dispersed.
The rural population halved between 1950 and 1990.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; net/seasonal + migration
examples: Migration kept the hospital staffed for forty years.
Seasonal migration follows the harvest exactly.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; immigration + policy/rises
examples: Immigration filled the jobs the mills had left.
Immigration policy changed nine times in a decade.

items.meaning: sự di cư ra nước ngoài
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; mass + emigration
examples: Mass emigration took a third of the parish.
Emigration slowed when the ferries stopped.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; net migration + of + số liệu
examples: Net migration ran at nine thousand a year.
Net migration turned negative for one unusual year.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; internal migration + from + N
examples: Internal migration from the coast to the capital never stopped.
Internal migration explains most of the growth.

items.meaning: di cư từ nông thôn ra thành phố
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; rural-urban migration + accelerates
examples: Rural-urban migration emptied nine villages in a generation.
Rural-urban migration accelerated after the land reform.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; forced migration + follows conflict
examples: Forced migration followed the flooding of the valley.
Forced migration is counted badly and remembered exactly.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a first-generation + immigrant
examples: Her grandfather arrived as an immigrant in 1954.
Immigrants founded nine of the town's businesses.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; an + emigrant + leaves
examples: The emigrants sent money home for forty years.
Nine emigrants from one street are buried abroad.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + refugee + flees/is resettled
examples: Nine refugee families were housed in the old vicarage.
A refugee has a legal status; a migrant has a journey.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; an + asylum seeker + waits
examples: Asylum seekers wait nine months for a first decision.
An asylum seeker may not work while waiting.

items.meaning: người bị buộc rời chỗ ở
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + displaced person + returns
examples: Nine hundred displaced persons passed through the camp.
A displaced person is counted when they cross a line.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; a + resettlement + scheme
examples: The resettlement scheme took nine families a year.
Resettlement works when the housing is arranged first.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; tighten + border control
examples: Border control was tightened and the routes moved.
Border control at that crossing takes four hours.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; reform + immigration policy
examples: Immigration policy is written for headlines and applied to families.
Reforming immigration policy took three governments.

items.meaning: hệ thống tính điểm xét nhập cư
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + points-based system + selects
examples: A points-based system favours salary over need.
The points-based system excluded the care sector entirely.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; apply for/hold + a residence permit
examples: The residence permit runs for five years.
She held a residence permit and no bank account.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; apply for + naturalisation
examples: Naturalisation took nine years and four fees.
Naturalisation ends with a ceremony in the town hall.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; sit/pass + a citizenship test
examples: The citizenship test asks questions most citizens would fail.
She passed the citizenship test at the second attempt.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; face/a + deportation + order
examples: The deportation order arrived after nineteen years of residence.
Deportations rose after the policy change.

items.meaning: người di cư không giấy tờ
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; an + undocumented migrant + works
examples: Undocumented migrants pick the harvest and pay the rent.
An undocumented migrant cannot report a crime safely.

items.meaning: việc tổ chức đưa người lậu
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; tackle + people smuggling
examples: People smuggling grew as the legal routes closed.
People smuggling is a business built on desperation.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; family planning + services
examples: Family planning services reached the villages in the 1970s.
Family planning changed the birth rate faster than any slogan.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; access to + contraception
examples: Access to contraception explains most of the change.
Contraception was unavailable to unmarried women until 1967.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; average + household size
examples: Average household size fell from four to two in a lifetime.
Smaller household size means more homes for the same population.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + single-person household + grows
examples: Single-person households are now the commonest kind.
A single-person household pays the same standing charges.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + multigenerational household + shares
examples: Multigenerational households rose with the rents.
A multigenerational household solves childcare and nothing else.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; raise/reach + the retirement age
examples: The retirement age rose twice in a decade.
She reached retirement age and carried on working.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; excess/measure + mortality
examples: Excess mortality that winter reached nine thousand.
Mortality is recorded weekly and understood slowly.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; fear of + overpopulation
examples: The fear of overpopulation shaped policy for two decades.
Overpopulation is a question about consumption as much as numbers.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; rural + depopulation
examples: Rural depopulation closed the last two schools.
Depopulation and second homes arrived in the same decade.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; increasing + longevity
examples: Increasing longevity is the good news in the pension problem.
Longevity in that valley is unusually high.

items.definition: danh từ số nhiều; register/vital statistics + record
examples: Vital statistics have been recorded since 1837.
Vital statistics reveal the epidemic before the doctors do.

items.definition: repopulate + N; thường bị động
examples: Nine villages were repopulated by families priced out of the city.
They repopulated the terraces with students.

items.definition: immigrate to + N
examples: Her parents immigrated in 1962.
Nine thousand immigrated to that city in one year.

items.definition: emigrate to/from + N
examples: Two brothers emigrated and one returned.
He emigrated at nineteen with a single case.

items.definition: settle in + N; settle down there
examples: They settled in a town with work and no relatives.
Nine families settled on the same street.

items.definition: resettle + sb; thường bị động
examples: Nine households were resettled from the flood plain.
They were resettled twice in four years.

items.definition: deport + sb; thường bị động
examples: He was deported after nineteen years of work.
They deported nobody and threatened everybody.

items.definition: flee + N; flee from + N
examples: They fled the fighting with what they could carry.
Nine hundred fled the valley in one night.

items.definition: outnumber + N
examples: Arrivals outnumbered departures for the first time in 1998.
Pensioners outnumber children in nine wards.

items.definition: disperse + N; thường bị động
examples: The community was dispersed across four counties.
Families were dispersed by the housing allocation.

items.definition: demographic + N (change, pressure)
examples: Demographic pressure on the schools arrived before the housing.
The demographic case for the line was never made.

items.definition: a populous + N (region, country)
examples: The most populous district has the fewest councillors.
A populous country can still be empty in places.

items.definition: a sparsely populated + N (area, county)
examples: The sparsely populated uplands lost their bus service first.
A sparsely populated county cannot support nine clinics.

items.definition: an ageing + N (workforce, village)
examples: An ageing workforce needs a training plan, not a sigh.
The ageing village has one shop and nine volunteers.

items.definition: a youthful + N (population, profile)
examples: A youthful population is an asset for twenty years.
The youthful profile of the city shapes its politics.

items.meaning: không có giấy tờ hợp pháp
items.definition: an undocumented + N (worker, resident)
examples: Undocumented workers built much of the district.
An undocumented resident appears in no statistic.

items.definition: the + foreign-born + population
examples: The foreign-born population is a fifth of the city.
Foreign-born residents are younger on average.

items.definition: the + native-born + population
examples: Native-born residents left as the rents rose.
The native-born population is ageing faster.

items.definition: a transient + N (population, workforce)
examples: A transient population makes a school roll unpredictable.
The workforce is transient and the problems are permanent.

items.definition: a settled + N (community, status)
examples: A settled community keeps the hall open.
Settled status was granted after nine years.

items.meaning: đang tham gia lực lượng lao động
items.definition: the + economically active + population
examples: The economically active population fell by a tenth.
Only half the adults are economically active in that ward.

items.definition: move away; move away from + N
examples: The young moved away and sent money back.
Nine families moved away in one summer.

items.definition: move abroad; không có tân ngữ
examples: They moved abroad for work and stayed for the weather.
Nine nurses moved abroad from one ward.

items.definition: take in + sb hoặc take + sb + in; tách được
examples: The town took in ninety families within a month.
They took two students in for a whole year.

items.definition: turn away + sb hoặc turn + sb + away; tách được
examples: Nobody was turned away from the hall that night.
They turned away nine applicants on the same ground.

items.definition: send back + sb hoặc send + sb + back; tách được
examples: Families were sent back to a country they had left as children.
They sent the papers back twice.

items.definition: thin out; không có tân ngữ
examples: The old trades thinned out with that generation.
Numbers thinned out every winter.

items.definition: level off; không có tân ngữ
examples: Growth levelled off after 2008.
Arrivals levelled off and the rents did not.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + life course + approach
examples: A life course approach looks at the whole sixty years.
The life course assumed by the pension rules no longer exists.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; household formation + outpaces building
examples: Household formation outpaced building for twenty years.
Household formation slowed when the young stayed at home.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + net outflow + of + số liệu
examples: A net outflow of nine thousand emptied the coalfield.
The net outflow reversed in a single year.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + migration corridor + runs
examples: The migration corridor runs along the old railway.
Nine countries share that migration corridor.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; the + second generation + settles
examples: The second generation spoke the language and lost the dialect.
The second generation outperformed both their parents and their neighbours.

items.meaning: sự thay thế giữa các thế hệ
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; generational replacement + changes opinion
examples: Generational replacement changed the vote without anyone changing their mind.
Generational replacement is slower than persuasion and more reliable.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; retirement migration + to the coast
examples: Retirement migration to the coast reshaped nine towns.
Retirement migration brings spending and care needs together.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + working life + of forty years
examples: A working life of fifty years is now the assumption.
Her working life began at fifteen and ended at seventy.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; the + parish register + records
examples: The parish register records every birth since 1593.
Nine generations appear in the same parish register.

items.meaning: quả bom dân số hẹn giờ
items.definition: be + a demographic time bomb
examples: The pension system was called a demographic time bomb in 1985.
Every ageing society is described as a demographic time bomb.

items.definition: be + a land of opportunity
examples: The city was a land of opportunity for exactly one generation.
They were sold a land of opportunity and found a boarding house.

items.term: in search of a better life
items.meaning: đi tìm cuộc sống tốt hơn
items.definition: come/leave + in search of a better life
examples: They crossed a continent in search of a better life.
Nine million left in search of a better life and most found work.

items.definition: the old country
examples: The old country was discussed every Sunday and visited twice.
Letters from the old country arrived for forty years.

items.meaning: thế hệ kẹp giữa hai gánh

Population movement is recorded by school rolls before any census.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + push factor + drives migration

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + pull factor + attracts

The pull factor was a cousin with a spare room.

items.meaning: di cư theo chuỗi quan hệ

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; return migration + rises

Return migration is the part nobody counts.

items.meaning: di cư vòng tròn theo mùa
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; circular migration + between + N

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; the + ethnic composition + of + N
examples: The ethnic composition of the ward changed within a decade.
Ethnic composition is recorded in the census and argued about afterwards.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; uneven + population distribution

Uneven population distribution leaves nine villages without a bus.

items.meaning: khả năng chịu tải dân số
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; exceed + carrying capacity

Carrying capacity depends on technology as much as on land.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; the same + age cohort
examples: That age cohort entered work in a recession.
Nine age cohorts are tracked in the study.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a falling + school roll
examples: A falling school roll closed the junior department.
The school roll predicts the housing need nine years ahead.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; fund/a + care home place
examples: A care home place costs more than a nurse's salary.
Nine care home places were lost when the home closed.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; adequate + pension provision

Adequate pension provision for carers was never designed.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + worker shortfall + of + số liệu
examples: A worker shortfall of nine hundred followed the emigration.
The worker shortfall in care has lasted nine years.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; skilled migration + routes
examples: Skilled migration kept nine hospitals staffed.
Skilled migration routes exclude the sectors that need people most.

items.meaning: chương trình lao động theo mùa
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + seasonal worker scheme + operates
examples: The seasonal worker scheme brings four thousand pickers a year.
A seasonal worker scheme ties the visa to one farm.

items.meaning: chương trình hỗ trợ hoà nhập
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; run/an + integration programme
examples: The integration programme offers language classes and a bus pass.
An integration programme without housing achieves little.

items.meaning: việc cộng đồng bảo lãnh người tị nạn
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; community sponsorship + of refugees
examples: Community sponsorship housed nine families in one parish.
Community sponsorship works where the state is slow.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + host community + adjusts
examples: The host community was consulted after the arrivals.
A host community with no spare housing resents what it is given.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + population projection + assumes
examples: The population projection assumed migration that never came.
Population projections are wrong in detail and useful in direction.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; apply for + family reunification
examples: Family reunification took four years and nine documents.
Family reunification rules decide who grows up with a parent.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; prevent + statelessness
examples: Statelessness passes from parent to child by accident of law.
Nine thousand people here live with statelessness.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; apply for/a + work visa
examples: The work visa is tied to a single employer.
A work visa costs more than a month's wages.

items.meaning: giấy phép bảo lãnh lao động
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; hold/lose + a sponsorship licence
examples: The nursing home lost its sponsorship licence.
Only employers with a sponsorship licence can recruit abroad.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + population register + records
examples: The population register records every change of address.
No population register exists here, which makes counting hard.

items.meaning: làn dịch chuyển về thành phố
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; urban drift + continues
examples: Urban drift has continued for a century and a half.
Urban drift leaves the oldest residents in the smallest villages.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; average + family size
examples: Average family size fell from five to two.
Smaller family size changed the whole housing market.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; the average + age at marriage
examples: The average age at marriage rose by nine years.
A later age at marriage follows longer schooling.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; voluntary + childlessness
examples: Childlessness is commoner in this cohort than in any before.
Voluntary childlessness is reported more honestly than it was.

items.meaning: sự chia cắt giữa các thế hệ
items.definition: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; a + generational divide + opens
examples: A generational divide opened over housing, not over music.
The generational divide in that vote was the widest recorded.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + birth certificate + records
examples: The birth certificate records a village that no longer exists.
Without a birth certificate she could claim nothing.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; issue/a + death certificate
examples: The death certificate gave two causes.
Nine death certificates were issued that week in one ward.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; the + marriage rate + falls
examples: The marriage rate has halved since 1972.
A falling marriage rate says nothing about couples.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; the + divorce rate + peaks
examples: The divorce rate peaked and then fell with the marriage rate.
The divorce rate is highest in the fourth and fifth years.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; the + remarriage rate + among men
examples: The remarriage rate among men is twice that among women.
The remarriage rate falls sharply after sixty.

items.meaning: mang thai ở tuổi vị thành niên
items.definition: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; teenage pregnancy + rates
examples: Teenage pregnancy rates fell by two thirds in twenty years.
Teenage pregnancy fell fastest where contraception was free.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; late parenthood + becomes common
examples: Late parenthood is now the norm among graduates.
Late parenthood changes the whole shape of a family.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + life stage + transition
examples: Each life stage used to arrive at a predictable age.
Nine life stages are assumed by that benefit system.

items.meaning: già đi tại nơi đang sống
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; support + ageing in place

Ageing in place keeps people in the street they know.

items.meaning: sự chăm sóc không chính thức
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; rely on + informal care

The system assumes informal care that may not exist.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; assess/a + care need

A care need of two hours a day keeps someone at home.

items.meaning: thiết kế phù hợp người cao tuổi
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; age-friendly design + of streets

Age-friendly design is cheaper than treating the falls.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; tackle/chronic + loneliness

Loneliness rose among the youngest group, not the oldest.

items.meaning: sự cô lập về xã hội
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; reduce + social isolation

Social isolation is measured by how many days pass without a conversation.

items.definition: đếm được hoặc không; after/a + bereavement

Bereavement support was offered a year too late.

items.meaning: tình trạng mất vợ hoặc chồng
items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; enter + widowhood
examples: Widowhood lasts an average of nine years here.
Widowhood brought poverty as well as grief in that generation.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + care worker + visits
examples: Care workers are paid less than the shelf-stackers.
One care worker visits nine houses before noon.

items.meaning: người giúp việc nhà cho người cần hỗ trợ
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + home help + comes

Home helps were replaced by fifteen-minute visits.

items.meaning: việc tạm giữ người nhập cư

Immigration detention costs more than housing the same family.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; hold sb in + a detention centre

Two detention centres were closed after the inquiry.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; a + voluntary return + scheme

Voluntary return is rarely entirely voluntary.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + border crossing + opens

Nine thousand people use that border crossing weekly.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; live in/a + refugee camp

A refugee camp becomes a town nobody planned.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + reception centre + processes
examples: The reception centre processes nine hundred arrivals a month.
A reception centre was opened in a disused barracks.

items.meaning: khu vực phân bổ người xin tị nạn
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + dispersal area + receives

Nine dispersal areas carry most of the national total.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; be granted + the right to remain

The right to remain was refused and won on appeal.

items.meaning: quyền cư trú không thời hạn

items.meaning: môi trường chính sách khắt khe với người nhập cư

items.meaning: việc ân xá hợp thức hoá
items.definition: danh từ đếm được; grant/an + amnesty

The cap on numbers was met by March.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + population boom + follows

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; fertility decline + continues

Fertility decline began long before the pill.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + remittance flow + supports

The remittance flow exceeds the aid budget.

items.meaning: hình thái phân bố dân cư

Nine shrinking cities share the same problem of empty streets.

items.meaning: thị trấn mới xây theo quy hoạch

New towns were planned around the car.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; apply for/a + study visa

Nine thousand study visas were issued in that quarter.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; hold + the right of abode

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + net inflow + of + số liệu

items.definition: dwindle; dwindle to + N

items.definition: swell; swell to + N

examples: The population is projected to fall by a tenth.

items.definition: be/remain + childless

Childless households are the fastest growing group.

items.definition: be dependent + on + sb

items.definition: pensionable + age
examples: Pensionable age rose to sixty-six.
Nine per cent work beyond pensionable age by choice.

items.meaning: có tính di chuyển theo mùa
items.definition: migratory + N (labour, pattern)

items.definition: a displaced + N (family, community)

A displaced community keeps its institutions longest.

items.definition: be + stateless

items.definition: a multi-ethnic + N (city, workforce)

items.definition: grow old; grow old together

items.definition: pass away; không có tân ngữ

items.definition: move on; move on to + N

Nine tenants moved on within a year.

items.meaning: người thuộc thế hệ bùng nổ sinh

items.definition: make a fresh start

items.definition: start a new life

items.definition: look for + a place in the sun

items.definition: the land of one's birth

topics.title: Sport & Active Lifestyles

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + daily step count + of + số liệu

Her daily step count halved when she changed jobs.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; physical/moderate + exertion
examples: Moderate exertion four times a week is the whole prescription.
Any exertion left him breathless that winter.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; do/a hard + workout
examples: The workout lasts forty minutes with no equipment.
A hard workout twice a week suits most beginners.

Nine training sessions a week is a full-time job.

His fitness improved once he stopped driving to work.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; an + endurance + event

Endurance matters more than speed in that race.

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; do + strength training

items.meaning: độ linh hoạt của cơ thể

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; do/a + cool-down

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; do + stretching

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; do + aerobic exercise

items.meaning: thương tích khi chơi thể thao

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; get/a + twisted ankle

The twisted ankle was treated with ice and patience.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + pulled muscle + heals

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; a + running track + opens

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; book/a + sports hall

Nine water sports are taught at the reservoir.

items.definition: danh từ đếm được; an + extreme sport + attracts

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; compete in + athletics

items.definition: danh từ không đếm được; do + gymnastics
